jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.description:
Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced **Business Analyst** to support a multi\-year modernization initiative focused on replacing legacy systems with a modern, cloud\-based technology environment.

The Business Analyst will work closely with business stakeholders, product owners, developers, QA teams, and technical resources to understand business processes, define requirements, document workflows, develop user stories, and support functional testing and User Acceptance Testing (UAT).

The ideal candidate will have strong business analysis, process documentation, requirements gathering, testing, and stakeholder communication skills.

Key ResponsibilitiesProcess Analysis \& Documentation

* Engage with business teams to understand existing operational processes, workflows, challenges, and opportunities for improvement.
* Work with technical and IT teams to understand technical capabilities and translate them into business requirements.
* Document current\-state processes using process maps, swimlane diagrams, workflow diagrams, and other structured documentation.
* Facilitate discussions with stakeholders to define and document future\-state processes.
* Identify process gaps, inefficiencies, dependencies, and opportunities for improvement.

Requirements Gathering \& User Stories

* Gather, analyze, and document detailed business and functional requirements.
* Translate business requirements into clear and actionable user stories.
* Develop detailed acceptance criteria that are complete, consistent, and testable.
* Create and maintain work items and user stories using Azure DevOps or similar tools.
* Collaborate with product owners, developers, QA teams, and business stakeholders to refine and validate requirements.
* Ensure requirements remain aligned with business objectives and project priorities.

Testing \& Quality Assurance

* Develop test plans, test cases, test scripts, and step\-by\-step testing instructions.
* Perform functional testing in development and test environments.
* Validate that implemented functionality meets documented requirements and acceptance criteria.
* Identify, document, and track defects through resolution.
* Perform regression testing and verify defect fixes.
* Coordinate, support, and/or lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT) with business stakeholders.
* Document test results and communicate testing status, issues, and risks.

Stakeholder Collaboration \& Communication

* Act as a liaison between business stakeholders and technical teams.
* Facilitate meetings, requirements workshops, process reviews, and UAT sessions.
* Communicate requirements, project updates, risks, issues, and dependencies clearly.
* Build strong working relationships with stakeholders across business and technology teams.
* Support change management activities, including training materials, process documentation, and user guidance.
* Proactively identify and communicate potential risks, gaps, and areas requiring clarification.

Required Qualifications \& Skills

* **5–7 years of experience** in business analysis, process analysis, requirements gathering, or a related role.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Experience analyzing and documenting business processes and workflows.
* Ability to create clear and structured process diagrams, workflow documentation, and process maps.
* Strong experience writing user stories and acceptance criteria.
* Experience developing test cases, test scripts, and functional testing documentation.
* Hands\-on experience with functional testing and User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
* Experience working with Azure DevOps or similar work item and project management tools.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong stakeholder management and facilitation skills.
* Ability to work effectively with both business and technical teams.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple requirements, priorities, and deliverables.

Preferred Experience

* Experience working on large\-scale technology modernization or digital transformation initiatives.
* Experience working with cloud\-based applications and modern technology environments.
* Experience working with Microsoft Azure or Azure\-based applications.
* Experience working in environments involving legacy system modernization and migration.
* Experience working with Agile or structured Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) methodologies.
* Experience supporting enterprise applications, public\-sector organizations, financial services, retirement systems, or similar complex business environments.

Work Location

**Remote / Oklahoma City, Oklahoma**

Remote work is supported; however, occasional in\-person attendance may be required for meetings or project activities in Oklahoma City.

Candidates should be able to accommodate meetings and collaboration during standard business hours.

Work Schedule

Typical working hours are:

**8:00 AM – 5:00 PM Central Time**

Some flexibility may be available based on project requirements and manager approval.

Engagement

This is a **5–7 year experience\-level Business Analyst opportunity** supporting a long\-term technology modernization program.

* The position will require close collaboration with business and technical stakeholders and involvement throughout the requirements, development, testing, and implementation lifecycle.

Pay: $71,434\.98 \- $86,029\.23 per year

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
**About Reel25**

Reel25 is a short\-form video intelligence platform for agencies, brands, and founders. Customers add public TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts accounts or videos by URL, then use one dashboard to track performance, compare creators, spot emerging patterns, and understand which content converts.

The product works across individual videos and thousands of accounts, with recurring metric refreshes, analytics, AI\-assisted niche research, and tools that turn proven patterns into new scripts.

**The opportunity**

We are looking for an IT Project Manager to help Reel25 plan and deliver product, integration, and platform initiatives with clarity. You will coordinate work across engineering, product, design, and business stakeholders while keeping scope, risks, decisions, and dependencies visible.

We are open to candidates from project management, technical program management, delivery, implementation, or product\-operations backgrounds and will calibrate scope to experience.

This is a delivery role; coding experience is not required. You should be comfortable discussing these systems with engineers and turning technical work into clear plans, decisions, risks, and stakeholder updates.

**What you'll own**

* Turn product and technical goals into clear milestones, owners, dependencies, and acceptance criteria.
* Coordinate releases spanning frontend, backend, data workflows, integrations, infrastructure, and customer communication.
* Run lightweight planning, status, risk, and retrospective processes that help teams move faster.
* Identify blockers early, drive decisions to closure, and escalate with useful options.
* Maintain a reliable source of truth for priorities, delivery health, scope changes, and outstanding decisions.
* Partner with engineering leads on capacity, technical dependencies, reliability work, and release readiness.
* Coordinate incident follow\-ups and ensure agreed actions are completed.
* Improve delivery metrics and team workflows without unnecessary ceremony.

**What success looks like**

* Teams understand priorities, ownership, dependencies, and the definition of done.
* Risks and scope changes are visible early enough to support good decisions.
* Releases become smaller, more predictable, and easier to communicate.
* Cross\-functional meetings produce decisions and actions.
* Stakeholders receive concise, evidence\-based updates they can trust.

**What we're looking for**

* Experience helping deliver software, SaaS, data, integration, implementation, or comparable technical projects.
* Understanding of how product, frontend, backend, data, QA, and infrastructure work connect.
* Ability to organize multiple workstreams, dependencies, risks, and stakeholder expectations.
* Clear written communication, facilitation, prioritization, and follow\-through.
* Comfort discussing APIs, data workflows, cloud systems, testing, releases, and incidents with engineers.
* A pragmatic approach to Agile practices and process.

We do not require a particular degree, a fixed number of years, or a perfect match to every bullet. If you can demonstrate the core capabilities and are ready to learn the rest, we encourage you to apply.

**Helpful extras**

* Analytics products, AI\-enabled SaaS, social\-platform integrations, or subscription products.
* Scrum, Kanban, PMI, PRINCE2, or similar training; certification is not required.
* Privacy, security, compliance, vendor review, or incident follow\-up.
* Experience in a fast\-moving product environment.

**Why join**

* Work at the intersection of creator marketing, social data, analytics, and applied AI.
* Help customers replace manual spreadsheets and hours of scrolling with reliable product workflows.
* Influence a fast\-moving SaaS product used by agencies, brands, and founders.
* Solve meaningful scale, data\-quality, and user\-experience problems across multiple social platforms.

Pay: $80,000\.00 \- $100,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid time off

Work Location: Remote

jobs.description:
BridgePhase is a mission\-focused technology company that designs, builds, secures, and operates modern digital solutions that drive national security, government efficiency, and mission success across the Federal Government. We empower agencies to achieve meaningful outcomes through high\-performing software engineering, cloud, DevSecOps, cybersecurity, AI/ML, and platform modernization solutions delivered by collaborative teams focused on innovation, adaptability, and operational excellence. As a trusted partner, BridgePhase helps Federal organizations modernize critical systems, accelerate delivery, and achieve lasting mission impact.  

  

**Position Overview:**


In this role, you will serve as the primary point of contact for NS2 Cloud Customers within Federal Accounts, including both DoD and Federal Civilian (Fed\-CIV) agencies, focusing on S/4HANA RISE Private Cloud Edition (PCE).  

  

You will be responsible for strategic and operational delivery leadership, driving end\-to\-end customer engagement from contract signature onwards \- covering onboarding, service delivery execution, release and maintenance planning, governance and architecture oversight, and renewal strategy.  

  

This role requires a comprehensive understanding of DoD and Federal RAMP (FedRAMP, IL2–IL6\) regulations and compliance frameworks, ensuring cloud delivery models meet applicable federal cybersecurity and regulatory mandates  

  

* This position requires access to customer data. Must be a U.S. citizen. Fully remote position.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**  

  

Engagement \& Relationship Management* Serve as the senior\-level customer engagement lead and trusted advisor for Federal, DoD, and Fed\-CIV clients.
* Conduct regular executive and quarterly business reviews with customer leadership to evaluate service quality and business outcomes.
* Deliver and interpret balanced scorecards and performance KPIs to ensure overall customer satisfaction and drive continuous improvement.
* Translate Federal mission goals into aligned SAP NS2 cloud strategies and roadmaps, helping customers maximize the value and security of their SAP investments.


Delivery \& Operations Management* Lead complex onboarding/transition projects in DoD and Fed\-CIV regulated environments with an emphasis on compliance, security, and operational excellence.
* Serve as the single point of contact for service and support requirements across NS2 Cloud Services.
* Manage multi\-domain service delivery according to defined scope, budget, and milestones, ensuring alignment with FedRAMP and DoD Impact Level (IL) standards.
* Oversee incident management and escalation processes, collaborating with internal Mission Control Center (MCC) and Operations Control Center (OCC) teams.
* Develop and enforce quality and compliance plans to maintain adherence to Federal security and operational standards.
* Lead customer release and maintenance planning, including IT calendar management and version control to maintain regulated compliance posture.


Account \& Business Management* Build senior executive relationships across customer stakeholder organizations, including procurement, program management, and security compliance teams.
* Identify and develop upsell and service expansion opportunities across SAP NS2 cloud offerings, in collaboration with Sales and Solution teams.
* Support renewals, contract extensions, and commercial change requests ensuring alignment with compliance and delivery goals.
* Drive Cloud Application Services operating profit reviews and ensure service\-level adherence and SLA management.


Education \& Experience Requirements:* Bachelor’s Degree (or equivalent experience) in Business Administration, Computer Science, Technical Engineering, or a related field.
* 7\+ years of customer\-facing program or delivery management experience, preferably within Federal, DoD, or Fed\-CIV environments.
* Deep understanding of DoD Cloud security models, FedRAMP compliance, and NIST frameworks.
* Proven ability to lead delivery for multiple customers while maintaining high compliance and service quality standards.
* Strong executive communication, relationship building, and stakeholder management skills.
* Expertise in service delivery for SAP solutions, including S/4HANA, BTP, and SAC, with experience in Cloud Application and Technical Delivery.
* Demonstrated adaptability and innovative mindset toward adopting new technologies, such as AI and automation, to optimize delivery performance and operations.
* Experience with SAP or SAP NS2 preferred.


Desired Professional Training \& Certification:* ITIL Foundation or higher certification preferred.
* Working knowledge of SAP NS2 Cloud models, operating processes, and Federal compliance standards.
* Familiarity with DoD IL2–IL6 certification levels, FedRAMP, DISA STIGs, and related regulatory frameworks highly desirable.

*As with any dynamic technical environment, responsibilities will evolve based on mission needs. We are looking for individuals who are adaptable, proactive, and eager to take ownership of new challenges as they arise.*

jobs.description:
**Who We Are:**


Headquartered in Washington, DC, Versar Global Solutions provides full mission lifecycle solutions for challenges faced by our government and commercial Customers in the natural, built, and digital environments. With team members around the world and a rich legacy spanning more than 50 years, Versar Global Solutions delivers a broad array of planning, analysis and risk management solutions, project and program management, operations and maintenance services, and information technology applications for environmental management and remediation projects, mission critical facilities and installations, and in support of readiness and contingency operations.

**Who You Are:**


The Project Manager (PM) supports the Program Manager in planning and executing projects required in the performance of a United States Army Corps of Engineers (USACE) Recurring Maintenance and Minor Repair (RMMR) task order. The PM reports to the Program Manager and is responsible for duties include bidding, planning, organizing, coordinating, monitoring, and administering the work to successfully complete the requirements of the task order on time, within budget and in accordance with the company’s quality, safety, and regulatory requirements. The PM will support project execution throughout its lifecycle; track and coordinate administrative requirements, schedules, and budgets; utilize computerized maintenance systems; ensure clients’ or stakeholders’ requirements are met; process of invoices; manage and guiding project team members when needed.

jobs.title: Program Manager, Product Management
jobs.description:
**The Program Manager provides Product Management leadership with a single, trustworthy view of progress on the organization's strategic, large\-scale initiatives.** Examples include: product modernization, AI, and other transformational projects across a portfolio of 40\+ industry\-specific software products. Working at the intersection of product, engineering, and leadership, the Program Manager owns accurate status reporting, milestone tracking, and risk visibility for these key projects, **translating complex project details into clear, decision\-ready reporting for executives and stakeholders.**

This is a highly visible, cross\-functional role that succeeds through influence, disciplined communication, and data rather than direct authority. The Program Manager works directly with product owners and cross\-functional project teams to keep high\-stakes initiatives on track, and gives leadership a real\-time, honest picture of progress across the organization's most important product bets.


What You'll Do


**Manage and Report on Key Strategic Initiatives**

* Manage and support key large\-scale product projects. Actively manage progress on the organization's strategic product initiatives including product modernization, AI/ML integration, and other transformational, multi\-quarter projects as examples, partnering closely with product owners and project teams to keep work moving against plan.
* Own status reporting to leadership. Build and maintain accurate, timely, executive\-ready status reports and dashboards for key projects, giving leadership a clear, consolidated view of progress, milestones, budget/resourcing status, and delivery timelines across the portfolio.
* Track project health and key metrics. Define and monitor the milestones, KPIs, and success metrics for each large\-scale initiative, translating detailed project activity into concise, decision\-ready insight for leadership and flagging projects that are off track.

**Keep Initiatives On Track**

* Identify and escalate risks and issues. Proactively identify risks, issues, blockers, and cross\-team dependencies threatening a project's scope, schedule, or quality; maintain a clear view of open items and escalate to leadership with recommended paths forward.
* Run project governance and cadence. Establish and facilitate a regular cadence of project reviews and checkpoints with project teams and leadership ensuring each key initiative has a consistent forum for reporting progress, making decisions, and resolving blockers.
* Drive accountability across project teams. Hold project owners and cross\-functional contributors (engineering, design, product marketing, product management, sales, customer success) accountable to committed timelines and deliverables, following up on action items and unresolved issues between checkpoints.

**Communicate and Support Decision\-Making**

* Communicate with stakeholders. Tailor communication of project status and impact for different audiences, from individual project teams to senior executives, keeping stakeholders informed and aligned throughout each initiative's lifecycle.
* Support prioritization and planning. Provide leadership with the visibility needed to make informed trade\-off and sequencing decisions across the portfolio of large\-scale initiatives, based on current progress, risk, and resourcing.

**Who You'll Work With**

Product Management, Engineering, Design, Product Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success, as well as the Product leadership team. You will be the connective tissue that turns complex project details into consistent, decision\-ready reporting, and an honest, real\-time picture of how the organization's most important initiatives are performing.


**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 3–5 years of program or project management experience.
* Demonstrated experience managing and reporting on the progress of strategic projects from initiation through delivery.
* Hands\-on proficiency using AI tools for program management and reporting.
* Utilization and integration of AI in daily workflows.
* Proven ability to build clear, accurate, executive\-level status reports and dashboards and to present project progress confidently to senior leadership.
* Experience identifying, tracking, and escalating project risks, issues, and dependencies, and driving resolution with cross\-functional teams.
* Experience establishing and running project governance cadences (e.g., steering committees, project reviews, checkpoint meetings).

**Preferred**

* PMP certification; PgMP.
* Experience managing large\-scale, complex, or transformational initiatives in a software/SaaS or technology environment.
* Experience in a large, multi\-product software organization or a portfolio shaped by mergers and acquisitions, where products operate with a high degree of autonomy.
* Familiarity with ERP or vertical\-market/industry\-specific software.
* Experience working within or alongside a Product Management organization with product roadmaps and release processes.
* Experience presenting project updates to senior executive audiences.

**How Success Is Measured**

Performance is measured on a paired set of leading and outcome indicators across the role:


* **Reporting reliability.** Timeliness, accuracy, and leadership\-rated trustworthiness of status reporting and dashboards for key strategic initiatives.
* **Risk visibility**. Early identification and escalation of risks and issues — measured by how often problems are surfaced in time for leadership to act, rather than discovered after the fact.
* **Initiative outcomes**. On\-time, on\-track support of the organization's key modernization, AI, and other large\-scale product projects, and leadership\-rated confidence in the governance cadence.

D\&G is seeking **a Technical Project Manager** to provide focused planning, coordination, and execution oversight for D\&G's multidisciplinary Federal Government logistics modeling and simulation effort. This role aligns technical workstreams to scope, schedule, dependencies, milestones, risks, and customer decision needs while keeping deliverables coordinated and ready for review. The role is intentionally part\-time and concentrates on high\-value project integration, control, and stakeholder coordination rather than day\-to\-day technical execution.


**What You Will Do**


* Develop and maintain the integrated project plan, schedule, milestones, dependencies, work packages, owners, and completion criteria.
* Monitor scope, schedule, staffing assumptions, and delivery commitments; identify variances and coordinate corrective action.
* Coordinate activities, dependencies, handoffs, and integration across operations research, M\&S, data engineering, database architecture, and logistics SMEs.
* Facilitate technical working sessions and reviews, documenting decisions, actions, owners, and due dates.
* Manage project risks, issues, assumptions, and dependencies with clear owners, mitigations, and escalation thresholds.
* Escalate critical issues and decisions with concise context, options, impacts, and recommended actions.
* Coordinate customer engagements, status reporting, technical and quality reviews, and deliverables to maintain visibility and support on\-time delivery.


**What We Are Looking For**


*Required*


* Bachelor's degree from an accredited university in Engineering, Operations Research, Data Science, Computer Science, Business, Project Management, or a related field.
* 8\+ years of experience managing or coordinating technical, analytical, engineering, software, data, or modeling and simulation projects.
* PMP, PMI\-ACP, Scrum, SAFe, or comparable project/program management certification.
* Demonstrated experience managing integrated schedules, dependencies, risks, issues, decisions, reviews, and customer deliverables across multidisciplinary teams.
* Working knowledge of Federal Government contracting and project delivery, including scope control, deliverable management, and stakeholder reporting.
* Experience coordinating technical teams that include analysts, data engineers, software developers, architects, and operational SMEs.
* Strong technical communication, facilitation, organization, and executive\-level status reporting skills.


*Preferred*


* Experience supporting DoW or other Federal Government logistics, modeling and simulation, operations research, data, or mission\-analysis programs.


**Location**


* Remote
* 10% Travel to client site in Washington, D.C. as needed.


**Clearance and Eligibility**


* Must be able to attain a security clearance.
* This role is restricted to U.S. person(s) (U.S. citizens, permanent residents, and other protected individuals under 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3\)).

**Who We Are**  

*At D\&G Solutions, people come first; our teammates, customers, and the communities we serve.*  

We are one of the fastest growing companies in the Washington, DC area and proud to be recognized nationally as a Best Place to Work. As an 8(a), Service\-Disabled Veteran Owned, and Women Owned Small Business, we bring ownership, accountability, and care to everything we do. We also deeply believe in giving back and proudly support organizations such as Homes for Our Troops, SemperK9, and Wreaths Across America.  

Our teams are welcoming, collaborative, and deeply committed to mission success. We believe great work happens when people feel supported, respected, and trusted, and we work hard to create that environment every day.


**What We Offer**  

Competitive salary \| Benefits \| 401(k) \| Bonus and profit sharing \| Flexible hours \| Education reimbursement \| PTO


**Final Note**  

If you want to work for a company that cares about its people, contribute to a mission that truly matters, and be part of a team where you are valued for who you are as well as what you do, we would love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Program Manager
jobs.description:
**Own Every Moment at NetApp**


At NetApp, your ideas power innovation. We lead in intelligent data infrastructure—delivering unified storage, integrated data services, and solutions that help organizations unlock the full potential of their data, from AI to multicloud.


Ready to innovate and contribute to our path to $10B? Here, you'll collaborate with passionate teams, tackle real\-world challenges, and see your impact in how customers transform and grow. If you're ready to bring curiosity, creativity, and drive to every moment, NetApp is where your journey begins. Join teams that innovate to elevate, drive results, and excel together across every function.


**Program Manager**
===================


Remote \- US ; United States; Wichita, Kansas, United States; Morrisville, North Carolina, United States
**Job category:** Business Operations **Job ID:** 136023\-en\_US **Job Summary**
---------------


As a Product Structure \& Pricing Operations Manager, you will lead a cross functional core team chartered with defining, implementing, and ensuring readiness to execute Quote to Cash (QTC) on new product offering in the NetApp commerce tools across all NetApp products. You must be responsive, flexible and able to succeed within a collaborative team environment, managing multiple work streams, identifying risk, and implementing action plans to enable successful execution of the business requirements \& strategy to meet launch expectations.


**Job Requirements**
--------------------


* Min 8\+ years of experience in program management and/or related technical role.
* Leading a cross functional core team chartered with the definition of \& readiness to execute Quote to Cash functions on all NetApp products. This includes product structures \& pricing definition, tool setup, business process development, PSRR execution, project schedule \& risk management, content governance, and clear communication with business and content stakeholders.
* Representing the Commerce team in the Product Life Cycle (PLC) core team process from concept to EOS. Including understanding program goals, requirements, and development and communication of schedule, risk management, and impacts to the PLC Core teams and program reviews.
* Assess, analyze, consolidate, and communicate project status and risks clearly and succinctly to management, calling out key issues and presenting options for resolution to the cross\-functional executive teams.
* both tactical and long\-range vision to assign relative values and priorities within the context of the product portfolio; evaluating requirements against strategic objectives to prioritize investment and identify low performing offers.
* Lead our Executive PRC process including working with Executives to schedule reviews, provide meeting documentation, issue resolution, and governance to meet our Sox Compliance requirements.
* Understand, develop, enhance, mentor others in the use of key operational processes \& tools that directly impact quote to cash and the PSRR/PRC activities.

Preferred Skills:


* Strong working knowledge of the Quote to Cash, Product lifecycle, and end\-to\-end support processes.
* Ability to integrate feedback and to prove their adaptability to quickly changing contexts and work environments.
* Strong analytical skills are a must, including the ability to absorb and process multiple streams of information into actionable plans.
**Education**
-------------


* A Bachelor of Science degree in Engineering or Computer Science, a Masters degree or PhD or equivalent experience.
At NetApp, we embrace a hybrid working environment designed to strengthen connection, collaboration, and culture for all employees. This means that most roles will have some level of in\-office and/or in\-person expectations, which will be shared during the recruitment process.


**Equal Opportunity Employer:**


NetApp is firmly committed to Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) and to compliance with all federal, state and local laws that prohibit employment discrimination based on age, race, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, religion, disability or genetic information, pregnancy, protected veteran status, and any other protected classification.


**Why You'll Thrive at NetApp**


At NetApp, you won't wait for the perfect moment—you'll make it. The early planning, the extra thought, the bold idea that turns good into great: That's how our people operate and how we continue to push the boundaries of data infrastructure.


NetApp is the trusted partner for organizations transforming data into opportunity. As the only enterprise\-grade storage service natively embedded in Google Cloud, AWS, and Microsoft Azure, we empower customers to run everything from traditional workloads to enterprise AI with unmatched performance, resilience, and security.


**Our culture**


We celebrate mold breakers, bold thinkers, and problem solvers. We reward initiative, impact, and ownership. We provide flexibility so you can balance professional ambition with your personal life. Here, differences are not just welcomed—they drive everything we do.


If you're ready to innovate, rise to the challenge, and own every moment \- make your next move your best one. Apply now.


**Submitting an Application**


To ensure a streamlined and fair hiring process for all candidates, our team only reviews applications submitted through our company website. This practice allows us to track, assess, and respond to applicants efficiently. Emailing our employees, recruiters, or Human Resources personnel directly will not influence your application.


**AI Disclosure**


For select roles, some stages of our hiring process may use artificial intelligence tools to help evaluate applications and candidate selection. These tools support—rather than replace—human decision\-making.

jobs.title: Project Manager / Task Lead
jobs.description:
**Are you looking for a** **Challenge?** Looking for an innovative organization and the opportunity to learn and grow professionally? We can help! We are seeking a **Project** **Manager / Task Lead** to support the Internal Revenue Service's (IRS) Criminal Investigations (CI) Client Management Support Services (CMSS) \& U.S. Windows Client OS Support and Onsite Services contract at the IRS Headquarters in Washington, DC.


This is a remote opportunity.

***I've never heard of*** ***Terrestris. What do you do?***


At Terrestris, we leverage technology to create better mission outcomes through better human performance. We form strong client and team relationships through transparency and strive to create an environment where our team can let their excellence shine through. By finding, developing, and incorporating new ideas, we provide memorable services. Rooted in the USMC values of honor, courage, and commitment, Terrestris seeks to deliver extraordinary value to the American people by helping the Government become more efficient and effective.

***So, what will the Project*** ***Manager / Task Lead at Terrestris do?***


The **Project Manager / Task** **Lead** is responsible for leading and managing technology projects that support the IRS's desktop, endpoint, and user\-support environments. You will oversee the planning, coordination, deployment, and delivery of IT initiatives while ensuring projects remain on schedule, within budget, and aligned with organizational goals.You will also serve as the primary point of contact between the government and the contractor, managing contract performance, staffing, deliverables, and stakeholder communication. In addition, you will leads project meetings, track project risks and issues, prepare management reports and briefings, and ensure a smooth transition during the implementation, operation, and completion of technology projects.

***What does a typical day*** ***look like for a Project Manager / Task Lead?***


You will:


* Overall planning, coordination, execution, and delivery of endpoint engineering and deployment initiatives.
* Contract management; primary interface with government POCs; manage deliverables, staffing, and performance.
* Provide continuous project management support for User Support programs and projects.
* Manage scope, schedule, and budget; gather requirements and use cases.
* Maintain work breakdown structures (WBS) and project schedules.
* Lead/coordinate Integrated Project Team (IPT) meetings; track risks, issues, and action items.
* Prepare project\-management documents and stakeholder briefings; publish agendas/meeting notes.
* Maintain alignment with the Tech Ops PPPM initiative.
* Support transition\-in, steady\-state operations, and required transition planning/transition\-out activities.


***What******qualifications do you look for?***


You might be the professional we're looking for if you have:


* Authorization to permanently work in the United States without sponsorship.
* A minimum of 7 years of experience managing enterprise IT infrastructure or endpoint\-management projects, including at least 3 years supporting Microsoft enterprise technologies such as Intune, Windows 11, or Microsoft 365 in large\-scale environments.
* Experience coordinating cross\-functional teams and managing project schedules, risks, deployments, and operational transitions.
* PMP, CAPM, ITIL Foundation, PMI\-ACP, or equivalent industry\-recognized project\-management certification(s).
* Must undergo a High\-Risk Background Investigation and complete a 7\-panel drug screening.


***What kind of benefits does*** ***Terrestris Offer?***


We offer outstanding benefits including health, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, and work\-life programs. Our award programs acknowledge employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our service standards. Full\-time and part\-time employees working at least 20 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in our benefit programs. Other offerings may be provided for employees not within this category.


Terrestris is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EOE). Qualified applicants are considered for employment without regard to age, race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, disability, or veteran status. Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S.

jobs.title: UGC Program Manager
jobs.description:
**About Chief Detective:**


Chief Detective is a performance marketing agency helping fast\-growing startups and established retail brands scale revenue and acquisition through paid digital channels. Recognized as a top agency on Meta, we're expanding rapidly across platforms including TikTok, Google, and CTV.


We specialize in e\-commerce and partner with leading direct\-to\-consumer brands in luxury apparel, beauty, health \& wellness and lifestyle. Our clients include Rag \& Bone, Ursa Major, Buck Mason, Frank \& Eileen, TWP and more.


**About the Role:**


The UGC Program Manager owns the successful execution and continuous improvement of Chief Detective's User\-Generated Content (UGC) program. Serving as the operational hub between clients, Growth Partners, Creative Strategists, creators, and internal production teams, this role is responsible for delivering high\-quality creator content on time, on budget, and with exceptional communication throughout every stage of the process.


Success in this role extends beyond campaign coordination. The UGC Program Manager is expected to build and maintain a reliable creator network, proactively solve operational challenges, improve internal processes, and create a best\-in\-class experience for both clients and creators.


This role is ultimately accountable for ensuring our UGC program operates with consistency, transparency, urgency, and professionalism while continually evolving into a scalable, repeatable service offering.


**What You'll Do:**


**Creator Recruitment \& Relationship Management**


Own the sourcing, onboarding, and management of a diverse network of high\-quality UGC creators capable of supporting client objectives across multiple industries.


Responsibilities include:


* Source and recruit creators aligned with client demographics and creative needs
* Build and maintain an active creator database
* Vet creators for quality, communication, reliability, and turnaround speed
* Negotiate compensation and usage rights
* Manage creator relationships throughout campaign lifecycles
* Build a preferred roster of trusted creators for repeat engagement
* Continually expand and diversify the creator network


**UGC Campaign Management**


Manage multiple simultaneous UGC programs from kickoff through final asset delivery. The UGC Program Manager should confidently manage approximately **5–8 active client programs** simultaneously while maintaining exceptional organization and communication.


Responsibilities include:


* Coordinate creator outreach and selection
* Manage product shipments and creator logistics
* Distribute briefs and campaign requirements
* Execute creator contracts through DocuSign
* Track campaign milestones and deadlines
* Collect, organize, and deliver creator assets
* Coordinate revisions when necessary
* Ensure campaigns remain on schedule


**Client \& Internal Communication**


Serve as the operational point person for UGC campaign execution by maintaining proactive communication across internal teams and client stakeholders. No stakeholder should ever be surprised by the status of an active UGC campaign.


Responsibilities include:


* Provide timely campaign updates to Growth Partners and Senior Creative Strategists
* Communicate campaign progress and risks to clients in coordination with account stakeholders
* Escalate issues before they impact timelines
* Recommend operational solutions whenever challenges arise
* Ensure all stakeholders remain informed throughout campaign execution
* Maintain a high standard of professionalism and responsiveness


**Program Operations**


Maintain the systems, documentation, and workflows that keep the UGC program operating efficiently.


Responsibilities include:


* Maintain project tracking within ClickUp
* Organize creator documentation within Google Drive
* Develop and maintain Google Docs, Sheets, and briefing templates
* Execute creator agreements using DocuSign
* Track creator performance and historical engagement
* Ensure accurate documentation across every project
* Monitor deadlines and proactively resolve bottlenecks


**Program Development \& Continuous Improvement**


Help evolve Chief Detective's UGC offering through ongoing operational improvements.


Responsibilities include:


* Improve Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)
* Develop reusable documentation and templates
* Build creator playbooks and onboarding materials
* Document campaign learnings
* Produce internal case studies highlighting successful creator partnerships
* Identify operational inefficiencies and recommend improvements
* Improve turnaround times while maintaining quality standards
* Contribute to the long\-term scalability of the UGC program


**Success Metrics**


Success is measured not only by campaign completion, but by the confidence and trust built across clients, creators, and internal teams.


Key performance indicators include:


**Operational Excellence**


* Successfully manage 5–8 concurrent client programs
* Deliver campaigns on agreed timelines
* Maintain organized documentation across all projects
* Meet internal response\-time expectations
* Minimize missed deadlines


**Communication**


* Proactively communicate campaign progress
* Escalate risks before they become client issues
* Keep Growth Partners and Creative Strategists consistently informed
* Maintain timely responses across Slack and email
* Close communication loops without prompting


**Creator Network**


* Grow and strengthen the creator database
* Maintain relationships with top\-performing creators
* Improve creator turnaround time
* Reduce creator attrition
* Identify new creator sourcing opportunities


**Program Development**


* Continuously improve workflows
* Maintain current SOP documentation
* Develop case studies from successful campaigns
* Recommend process improvements
* Increase operational efficiency over time

* 3\+ years of experience in influencer m

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
**About the Role**
------------------

We are seeking an experienced **Senior Project Manager** for a **6\-month contract** supporting complex, time\-sensitive technology engagements within AT\&T Consulting.


In this role, you will serve as a key point of contact between AT\&T Consulting, account management, technical teams, customers, and customer\-approved third parties. You will oversee projects from planning through successful delivery, ensuring that customer requirements, timelines, scope, cost, and quality expectations are met.


This is a highly senior opportunity for a proven project or service delivery leader with extensive experience managing **network and/or security\-related projects** , large technical teams, and complex deployments across multiple time zones.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Serve as the primary project interface between:
	+ AT\&T Consulting
	+ AT\&T Account Management
	+ Other AT\&T teams
	+ Customer teams
	+ Customer\-approved third parties
* Lead complex, time\-restricted AT\&T Consulting engagements across the region.
* Apply established project management principles and AT\&T Project Management Framework best practices.
* Manage project scope, schedules, costs, quality, and changing customer priorities.
* Proactively identify and resolve issues that may impact project delivery.
* Develop and maintain project plans, migration plans, and associated documentation.
* Manage end\-to\-end service delivery activities, including:
	+ Architecture and design
	+ Engineering
	+ Change control
	+ Operations acceptance
* Maintain project **Risks, Issues, and Actions Logs** .
* Communicate project issues, actions, decisions, and outcomes to appropriate stakeholders.
* Direct the day\-to\-day activities of security and network teams in accordance with the project plan.
* Coordinate forums and meetings to address complex scope, issues, and analysis.
* Document meeting discussions, action items, and outcomes.
* Build strong relationships across project and program teams to ensure timely delivery.
* Prepare executive\-level project overviews and communicate critical issues to senior management.
* Ensure all required project and service documentation is delivered on time.
* Lead global deployment initiatives involving network and/or security technologies.

The role requires extensive proven delivery experience in global network and/or security\-related projects.


**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree (B.A. or B.S.).
* **25\+ years of experience in the IT industry.**
* **15\+ years of experience as a Project Manager and/or Service Manager.**
* Industry\-related certification such as **PMP or PRINCE2** , with commensurate experience.
* Demonstrated experience delivering large\-scale network and/or security projects.
* Excellent customer\-facing and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Business\-level proficiency in **English and Spanish** , both written and spoken.
* Experience managing resources and teams across multiple time zones.
* Experience managing large teams of technical and non\-technical consultants.
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision in a non\-structured environment.
* Strong problem\-solving skills with a customer\-focused and strategic approach.
* Ability to work effectively under challenging timeframes and pressure.
* Confidence communicating with senior management, including during critical situations or outages.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including **Excel, Word, Project, and PowerPoint** .
* Experience working within a change\-control environment.
* Knowledge of testing strategies and defining acceptance criteria.
* Experience delivering products and services across multiple business verticals and technology vendors.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* **ITIL Foundation Certification v3 or later.**
* Experience creating dashboards using **Power BI and PowerApps** .
* Knowledge of **Smartsheet** .
* Experience in service management delivery and program management.
* Experience managing multiple large\-scale transformation programs with multiple workstreams.
* Experience managing Project Manager direct reports.
* Experience creating executive dashboards and automated reporting.
* Demonstrated ability to develop efficient approaches to project and program delivery.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

The successful candidate will be able to quickly step into a complex project environment, establish relationships with key stakeholders, and take ownership of delivery.


You will be expected to bring strong judgment, calm decision\-making, and a proactive approach to managing project risks and competing priorities. The role requires someone who can operate comfortably with both **senior executives and technical teams** , while keeping projects moving toward successful customer outcomes.


**Role Details**
----------------

* **Position:** Senior Project Manager
* **Contract Duration:** 6 Months
* **Department:** AT\&T Consulting / Project Management
* **Salary:** 40\-50/ usd hr
* **Industry:** Telecommunications \& IT Consulting
* **Project Focus:** Network \& Security
* **Languages:** English \& Spanish
* **Experience Level:** 25\+ years IT / 15\+ years Project or Service Management

jobs.title: Channel Program Manager
jobs.description:
**Channel Program Manager****Remote \- United States** **About the Role**
As Channel Program Manager, you will be responsible for developing, managing, and optimizing partner programs to drive business growth through indirect sales channels. This role works closely with partners, sales teams, and marketing to create strategies, incentive programs, and enablement initiatives that strengthen partner relationships. You will also track performance metrics, ensure compliance with program guidelines, and identify ways to improve partner engagement and overall program effectiveness.  

This role reports to the Vice President Global Channel Sales and will work within a matrixed organization to analyze the needs of the direct and channel partner sales teams. The Channel Program Manager will work with a variety of resources to design, develop and deliver relevant solutions. You will play a key role in the best practices of educating channel sales personnel on the skills needed to help prospect into identified authorized territories to generate new leads and prospects, or cross sell into existing customer base. **Responsibilities*** Work closely with sales, channel, and marketing teams to understand the corporate go\-to\-market strategies and how to integrate with channel partners. Cross\-functional team development of Channel Campaigns for execution through the channel partners, including, but not limited to, email marketing, social media, paid advertising, and event marketing through Channel Partners.
* Optimize the Channel process to improve Channel onboarding, enablement, and compliance.
* Produce high\-quality content with cross\-functional teams that speak to prospects’ pain points and highlights the benefits of our product offerings and the Channel Program.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including product, customer success, sales, marketing, and operations, to ensure Channel aligns with overall business objectives.
* Providing input and guidance into the development of relevant sales enablement tools, including but not limited to sales knowledge database and learning management system, designed to optimize value messaging and accelerate channel sales execution.
* Develop Partner Program collateral/documents and onboarding tools to enhance overall partner experience and communicate to partners.
* Maintaining a variety of delivery methodologies designed to engage channel partner sales teams with different learning experiences to drive new opportunities.
* Determining training needs through personal engagement with channel sales teams.
* Developing channel sales education curriculum with cross\-functional teams focused on outcome improvement in the areas of sales skills, opportunity management, and the delivery of value proposition of the company, technology, and service offerings.
* Developing measurement criteria for ongoing evaluation of channel sales education curriculum in accordance with overall sales competency and alignment with contemporary product value and messaging, by working internally with Sales Enablement and externally with Channel Partners.
* Provide management of Partner Portal to create an engaging platform for partners to interact with Blackboard (lead registration, opportunity tracking, commissions, etc.).
* Work with channel operations/IT to implement channel strategy, data/reporting, system workflows, and overall operational governance for the program.
* Developing effective relationships with Marketing, Product Support, Global Services, Finance, Engineering, and other departments as needed.
* This role requires 5\-10% travel internationally to attend internal meetings or conduct training in support of our direct and channel partner sales teams.

 **Required Skills and Experience*** Bachelor’s degree in business or related field or equivalent work experience
* 3\+ years of experience in software sales and channel development function working with Distributors and Resellers
* Skilled in Microsoft office suite (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint)
* Excellent oral and written communication skills
* Strong organizational skills with ability to handle various tasks without losing attention to detail
* Ability to work well as part of a team
* Experience using Salesforce.com for opportunity management, activity tracking, and reporting
* Strong follow\-up skills and drive to be successful

The company is the developer of the High Definition Stream Survey (HDSS) methodology, which integrates field video, GPS, depth, water quality, sonar, GIS, and other data to support stream and river assessment, habitat mapping, restoration planning, regulatory compliance, and resource management.

Trutta is seeking a highly organized and technically skilled GIS \& Data Analyst to support the processing, management, quality assurance, analysis, and visualization of environmental data collected through the High Definition Stream Survey (HDSS) and other projects.

Reporting directly to the Operations Manager, this position serves as a technical lead for GIS mapping, database organization, quality control of environmental classifications, data analysis, and reporting. The successful candidate will work closely with field staff, data classifiers, project managers, and scientists to ensure high\-quality deliverables for clients.

This position offers opportunities to develop new workflows, improve data management systems, and apply automation tools that increase efficiency across multiple projects.

* Create and maintain GIS maps and spatial datasets for environmental projects.
* Organize, manage, and maintain project databases and associated documentation.

* Analyze spatial and environmental datasets to identify trends and support project objectives.

jobs.title: Operations Research Analyst
jobs.description:
**Operations Research Analyst**  

Remote \| U.S. Citizenship Required \| Security Clearance Eligibility Required


**Why This Role Exists**  

*The work we do has real impact, and the people behind it matter just as much.*


D\&G is seeking an **Operations Research Analyst** to support Federal Government clients by designing, executing, and interpreting mission\-level modeling and simulation for complex logistics challenges. This position develops rigorous simulation scenarios for traditional heavy cargo and unmanned aerial cargo concepts, evaluates operational trade\-offs, stress\-tests network assumptions and constraints, and translates quantitative results into actionable capability gaps and return\-on\-investment (ROI) insights.


The role combines strong technical modeling skills with defense logistics knowledge to help government stakeholders understand where, when, and under what conditions alternative logistics concepts provide operational value.


**What You Will Do**


* Design and execute modeling and simulation algorithms or tools in support of logistics use cases, with a specific focus on heavy airlift cargo and Unmanned Aerial Systems (UAS) cargo requirements.
* Develop and execute credible, repeatable simulation scenarios that directly address defined logistics use cases and decision questions.
* Conduct comparative trade\-space analyses between manned and unmanned platform capabilities.
* Evaluate variables including payload capacity, runway independence, turnaround times, and overall network throughput.
* Design and execute sensitivity analyses and constraint testing to identify operational vulnerabilities and tipping points.
* Assess conditions such as degraded communications and denied runways to determine when UAS platforms gain or lose operational advantage.
* Synthesize raw simulation outputs and analytical metrics into actionable operational insights.
* Identify capability gaps and develop return\-on\-investment (ROI) narratives for government stakeholders.
* Translate complex quantitative findings into decision\-ready analytical products that clearly connect model outputs to mission impact.


**What We Are Looking For**


*Required*


* Bachelor's degree from an accredited university in Operations Research, Mathematics, or a closely related quantitative field.
* 8\+ years of experience in defense operations research, military logistics analysis, or mission\-level modeling and simulation.
* Proficiency in Python and SQL.
* Strong experience with discrete\-event and/or agent\-based simulation packages.
* Experience presenting modeling and simulation results, capability gaps, or ROI analyses to Federal Government stakeholders.
* Deep understanding of modeling and simulation as applied to logistics concepts and operational decision\-making.


*Preferred*


* Experience modeling transportation, distribution, cargo, or contested logistics networks.
* Experience analyzing manned and unmanned aerial logistics concepts or platform alternatives.
* Master's degree in operations research, Mathematics, Systems Engineering, Data Science, or a related quantitative discipline.


**Location**


* Remote
* 10% Travel to client site in Washington, D.C. as needed.


**Clearance and Eligibility**


* Must be able to attain a security clearance.
* This role is restricted to U.S. person(s) (U.S. citizens, permanent residents, and other protected individuals under 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3\)).


**Who We Are**  

*At D\&G Solutions, people come first; our teammates, customers, and the communities we serve.*  

We are one of the fastest growing companies in the Washington, DC area and proud to be recognized nationally as a Best Place to Work. As an 8(a), Service Disabled Veteran Owned, and Women Owned Small Business, we bring ownership, accountability, and care to everything we do. We also deeply believe in giving back and proudly support organizations such as Homes for Our Troops, SemperK9, and Wreaths Across America.  

Our teams are welcoming, collaborative, and deeply committed to mission success. We believe great work happens when people feel supported, respected, and trusted, and we work hard to create that environment every day.


**What We Offer**  

Competitive salary \| Benefits \| 401(k) \| Bonus and profit sharing \| Flexible hours \| Education reimbursement \| PTO


**Final Note**  

If you want to work for a company that cares about its people, contribute to a mission that truly matters, and be part of a team where you are valued for who you are as well as what you do, we would love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Senior Security Operations Analyst (Detection & Response)
jobs.description:
### **About Point**


**✨ Real Impact, Real People:** Our mission at Point is to make homeownership more valuable and accessible. Your work directly helps homeowners access their wealth, achieve financial flexibility, and realize life changing goals.


**✨ Funding:** With over $175M raised from top investors like Andreessen Horowitz, WestCap, Greylock, and Prudential, we're scaling fast! You have the opportunity to join us at a pivotal stage.


**✨ Game\-changing Product:** We're building a category defining company in home equity. We've earned a 4\.7 Trustpilot rating and an A\+ from the BBB, a testament to the value we provide to our 20,000\+ customers.


**✨ Great Place to Work:** Our employees love working here! We are a Certified Great Place to Work and a Fortune Best Workplaces in the Bay Area.


**✨ Remote First Culture, Genuine Connection:** Work from anywhere in the U.S., while staying closely connected through virtual collaboration, team gatherings, and a people\-first culture.

  


**Local or 100% Remote**

  


**About the role**



Point Digital Finance is expanding its Information Security function, and this is the team's first dedicated monitoring and response hire — a high\-visibility role with immediate, measurable impact. As Senior Security Operations Analyst (Detection \& Response), you will be the second half of an incident\-response rotation, partnering directly with the security lead to detect, investigate, and contain threats across a regulated consumer\-finance environment that protects the financial data of hundreds of thousands of homeowners. This is not an alert\-watching seat: you will engineer the detections, automate the response, and harden how we see our AWS, Google Workspace, and SaaS estate. You'll help stand up a modern detection \& response practice from an early\-stage footing, with the autonomy to own problems end to end and the mandate to turn noisy alerts into fast, repeatable, well\-documented response. If you like building as much as responding — and want your work to directly reduce risk to real people's financial lives — this role is for you.



Check out our latest Engineering Blog to learn more about why it's a great time to join Point's Engineering team!

  


**Your responsibilities**


* **Rotate on\-call and lead response:** share the 24/7 on\-call and incident\-response rotation with the security lead — triaging, investigating, and driving containment of security alerts and incidents.
* **Own response documentation:** build and maintain incident\-response runbooks, escalation paths, and post\-incident reviews so response is consistent and repeatable.
* **Engineer detections:** build, tune, and maintain SIEM detections, correlation rules, dashboards, and reporting in Coralogix across cloud and identity log sources.
* **Close coverage gaps:** reduce false positives and onboard new log sources to eliminate detection blind spots.
* **Own vulnerability management:** run day\-to\-day vulnerability management — prioritize findings, coordinate remediation with system owners, and report on risk reduction across cloud and endpoints.
* **Automate response:** develop detection\-as\-code and lightweight automation/SOAR so common alerts self\-triage and response is faster and repeatable.
* **Add operational redundancy:** serve as a redundant administrative and response path so containment is never bottlenecked on a single person.
* **Report and evidence:** produce recurring security metrics and reporting for leadership, and supply control evidence for audits.
* **Apply AI to the workflow:** use AI/LLM tooling to accelerate investigation, correlation, and detection engineering.
* **Improve the program:** contribute to continuous improvement of the security\-operations program, tooling, and threat monitoring.

  


**About you**


* 5\+ years of experience in security operations, incident response, SOC, or detection engineering (mid\-to\-senior individual contributor).
* Hands\-on experience running or actively participating in an on\-call / incident\-response rotation, independently.
* Strong SIEM skills — authoring and tuning detections, correlation rules, and dashboards (Coralogix, Splunk, Elastic, Microsoft Sentinel, or similar).
* Practical cloud security experience in AWS and Google Workspace, including identity and log sources.
* Demonstrated ability to investigate and contain incidents end to end — e.g., phishing/AiTM, account takeover, business email compromise, and cloud/identity threats.
* Working knowledge of vulnerability management and coordinating remediation with engineering teams.
* Scripting and automation ability (Python or similar) for detection\-as\-code and SOAR\-style workflows.
* Clear written and verbal communication — able to produce runbooks, metrics, and audit\-ready documentation.
* Comfortable operating with autonomy on a small team and owning problems end to end.
* Authorized to work in the United States, and able to participate in an off\-hours on\-call rotation.


**Nice to have**


* Hands\-on experience using AI/LLMs for security analysis, investigation, and alert engineering (detection authoring, correlation, tuning, and automation).
* Experience in a regulated financial\-services or fintech environment (GLBA, NYDFS Part 500, SOC 2\).
* Relevant certifications (e.g., GCIA, GCIH, GCED, GIAC, CySA\+, Security\+, or AWS Security Specialty).
* Experience standing up detection \& response practices from an early or greenfield state.

  



Compensation at Point will be determined by skills, experience, and geographic location. Point has identified the expected annual base salary for this role at this level based on the market by tiers (Region \| Location \| Market Salary):


* Tier 1 \| San Francisco Bay Area, New York, and Seattle \| $151,050 \- $166,950
* Tier 2 \| Austin, Boston, Chicago, Denver, Los Angeles, Miami, Philadelphia, Portland, Sacramento, San Diego, Santa Barbara \& Washington DC \| $127,300 \- $140,700
*

Join the fight against climate change and take advantage of a unique opportunity on the cutting edge of climate policy at the New York City Department of Buildings (DOB). In a city where buildings contribute nearly three\-quarters of our greenhouse gas emissions, a focus on efficiency, building energy usage, and decarbonization is critical. * Leading the development and implementation of analytics tools, decision support systems, and dashboards to support policy and operational decisions
* Translating complex data analyses into actionable insights for policy development, regulatory compliance, and building decarbonization strategies
* Supporting and contributing to special projects as assigned by Bureau and Agency leadership, providing technical expertise and analytical rigor

jobs.description:
**OVERVIEW**  

  

A popular year\-round destination, Governors Island is a 172\-acre island in the heart of New York Harbor located between Lower Manhattan and the Brooklyn waterfront. For almost two centuries, the Island was closed to the public, operating as a military base for the U.S. Army and, later, the Coast Guard. Today, an award\-winning new park is complemented by dozens of unique historic buildings, educational and cultural facilities, a rich arts and culture program and a 22\-acre National Monument managed by the National Park Service. Looking ahead, the long\-term vision for Governors Island focuses on continuing to expand year\-round public access by enlivening it with transformative public art and culture, extraordinary recreational and open space, and research and education dedicated to addressing the global climate crisis.  

  

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**  

  

The Project Manager, Real Estate \& Planning supports all aspects of the planning, leasing, and development of the Island in furtherance of the Trust’s mission and financial goals.  

  

The real estate department’s portfolio includes ground leased public\-private development projects; turn\-key space leases, including collaboration with the Design and Construction team on delivery of new spaces; and seasonal concessions. The Project Manager will lead or assist in all phases of the department’s projects, including initial project planning, research, and modeling; preparation and management of RFPs or other solicitations; lease and other contract negotiations; funding and financing; and coordination of landlord and tenant improvements. Throughout, the Project Manager will be responsible for:* Managing project timelines, budgets, and key issues
* Timely responding to tenant leads and other inquiries, and maintaining a prospect pipeline for various projects
* Contracting and coordinating outside services, such as appraisals, surveys, and studies as necessary
* Tracking project progress, performance, and key milestones and maintaining clear and organized project files
* Clearly communicating with prospective partners, existing tenants, Trust leadership, and other stakeholders
* Working closely with colleagues in other departments including but not limited to Legal, Design and Construction, Property Management, and Public Affairs

**QUALIFICATIONS**
==================

**Education:*** Bachelor’s degree required; graduate degree in real estate, business, finance, public policy, urban planning, or similar field preferred.

**Experience:*** Minimum of two years of experience in a relevant field.

**Skills and Abilities:*** Proactive and self\-directed, with an ability to create and maintain project momentum, display a high degree of responsiveness and follow\-through, and juggle multiple high\-priority projects simultaneously
* Strong quantitative, financial analysis and real estate modelling (MS/Excel)
* Proven ability to contribute to complex negotiations
* Civic\-minded, with a strong commitment to advancing the Trust’s mission
* Experience with public space and public processes in New York City a plus
* Decision making and communication skills commensurate with a position that is frequently required to represent the organization with external parties
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, and an ability to synthesize complex issues and present them clearly
* Entrepreneurial spirit
* Valid drivers license

**Salary Range:** $75,000\-$85,000 per year  

  

**Location \& Schedule:** All positions are located on Governors Island. The position is in\-person four days per week and remote one day per week.  

  

**TO** **APPLY**  

  

We realize that not all applicants match 100% of the qualifications for a role. If you meet many but not all the criteria and feel you may be a good fit for this role, we encourage you to apply.  

  

The Trust for Governors Island values the importance of inclusion, accessibility and a diverse pool of applicants. The Trust for Governors Island does not discriminate on the basis of age, color, disability, genetic information, marital status, membership in an employee organization, military service, national origin, parental status, political affiliation, race, religion, sex (including gender identity), sexual orientation, sexual and other reproductive health decisions, or other non\-merit factor.  

  

**ABOUT THE TRUST FOR GOVERNORS** **ISLAND**  

  

The Trust for Governors Island (The Trust) is a nonprofit corporation created by the City of New York. It is responsible for the redevelopment and operation of 150 acres of Governors Island. The Trust's mission is to realize the full potential of Governors Island for the inspiration and enjoyment of all New Yorkers, demonstrating a bold vision for public space. For more information, visit www.govisland.org

jobs.title: Sr Program Manager, Process Improvement, GCF ACES
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


\*\*Location is flexible.  

  

The Global Customer Fulfillment (GCF) Amazon Customer Excellence System (ACES) team is seeking a Process Improvement Specialist to drive network\-wide projects and innovate new processes at scale. The individual will be a Process Path Owner (PPO) within ACES, where you are responsible for defining and maintaining the highest standards within your area of ownership. You are the subject matter expert (SME) for your process path, ensuring that all stakeholders—Operations, Central OPS, Tech, and ACES—are aligned with the right standards, tools, and mechanisms to drive performance. The role is flexible in terms of location, but requires reporting to an on\-site office.  

  

Your role goes beyond maintaining the current state; you are expected to think big, define a 1–3 year vision, and drive continuous improvement through scalable solutions. Your success is measured by how effectively you establish standard work, enable adoption, and make process adherence automatic rather than audit\-dependent.  

  

The Process Improvement Specialist role will challenge you to push boundaries and lead transformative innovation while having the autonomy to make rapid data\-driven decisions and invent on behalf of Fulfillment Center (FC) Operators and Associates. In this role, you will work cross\-functionally with members from various teams, including Operations, Amazon Fulfillment Technologies (AFT), Supply Chain Optimization Technology (SCOT), QuBIT, Global Logistics, Inbound Supply Chain, Finance, etc... to deploy solutions at scale.
  

  

Key job responsibilities  

Standard Work  

* Define standard work for your process path for associates and managers.
* Document standards for the “Gold Standard” for station design
* Ensure inaccurate / conflicting content is deprecated


Stakeholder Management  

* Be the central leader between Tech, Central Ops (PE, learning, etc..), Programs, Safety and Operations.
* Design feedback loops with customers to identify top priorities.
* Define a clear roadmap with Tech, ensuring prioritization aligns with business needs.


Process Path Performance  

* Conduct current state analysis to identify performance, key pain points and inefficiencies.
* Develop short\-term actions (0 – 3 months) and long\-term (1–3 years) roadmaps.
* Implement continuous improvements through Kaizens, automation, and tech investments.
* Peak Expectations \& Retrospective – Drive conversation for readiness for peak periods by analyzing past data, defining key operational thresholds, and conducting post\-peak evaluations to improve future performance.


Metrics  

* Own business logic and act as the source of truth for process path metrics.
* Define critical metrics and set targets, upper and lower thresholds.
* Deprecate outdated metrics.
* This role requires 50% travel within the United States.\*

  

A day in the life  

You will start by looking at key metrics in your process path and for the programs you support. You will visit a site to that is in Alpha testing and work in path with associates to understand what is and is not working well for your your programs and products. You will lead stakeholder alignment calls to define the path forward and update stakeholders on testing. You will lead training sessions for leaders on how to leverage the tool or product.
  

  

Amazon offers a full range of benefits that support you and eligible family members, including domestic partners and their children. Benefits can vary by location, the number of regularly scheduled hours you work, length of employment, and job status such as seasonal or temporary employment.
  

  

The benefits that generally apply to regular, full\-time employees include:
  

* Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage
* Maternity and Parental Leave Options
* Paid Time Off (PTO)
* 401(k) Plan

  

If you are not sure that every qualification on the list above describes you exactly, we'd still love to hear from you!
  

  

At Amazon, we value people with unique backgrounds, experiences, and skillsets. If you’re passionate about this role and want to make an impact on a global scale, please apply!  

  

About the team  

GCF ACES’ mission is to raise the bar on Amazon's customer experience by delivering holistic solutions that optimize process, tech and systems across the supply chain while balancing short, mid, and long\-term value stream. Our key programs and products aim to improve business outcomes across People, Defect reduction, DEA, Speed and Productivity. In doing so, we strive to bring parity to regions and develop solutions that are globally scalable and adapted to local levels.
**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
* 5\+ years of program or project management experience
* Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 2\+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Knowledge of general AI tools
* Experience designing, implementing, and scaling upskilling, apprenticeship, or workforce development programs across large\-scale operations or corporate environments, including forecasting workforce needs and leveraging analytics to drive program decisions

  

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.  

  

Los Angeles County applicants: Job duties for this position include: work safely and cooperatively with other employees, supervisors, and staff; adhere to standards of excellence despite stressful conditions; communicate effectively and respectfully with employees, supervisors, and staff to ensure exceptional customer service; and follow all federal, state, and local laws and Company policies. **Title: PeopleSoft Project Manager**  

**Location: New York, NY (Onsite)**  

**Duration: 12 Months**  

  

**Note:*** **Must be specialized in PeopleSoft PUM Upgrade projects**
* **Public Sector/Government Industry experience is preferred**
* **PMP and/or OCI certification preferred**
* **Only work authorizations without a need for sponsorship now or in the future will be considered.**

  

**Job Description:**  

We are looking for a PeopleSoft Project Manager to lead large\-scale PeopleSoft transformation initiatives, manage cross\-functional teams, engage with executive stakeholders, and ensure successful delivery of modernization programs involving PeopleSoft applications, databases, middleware, and cloud infrastructure. The Project Manager will be responsible for planning, governance, risk management, resource coordination, vendor management, and end\-to\-end execution of PeopleSoft upgrade and cloud migration projects while ensuring business continuity and compliance with organizational standards.
  

**What You'll Do*** Lead governance and end\-to\-end delivery of PeopleSoft PUM upgrade and OCI migration programs, driving execution through Agile or Hybrid methodologies while managing scope, risks, dependencies, issues, and change requests
* Establish project governance structures, reporting cadences, decision\-making frameworks, and escalation procedures to ensure effective program oversight and stakeholder alignment
* Develop and maintain integrated project plans, milestones, budgets, dependency tracking, and risk registers while monitoring project health against scope, schedule, budget, and quality objectives
* Coordinate steering committee meetings, executive status reviews, and leadership reporting to ensure timely milestone delivery, informed decision\-making, and successful program outcomes
* Serve as the primary point of contact for implementation partners while overseeing vendor performance, deliverables, milestones, resource commitments, and contractual obligations
* Review and challenge project plans, estimates, technical approaches, and delivery schedules to ensure alignment with project objectives and organizational requirements
* Drive vendor accountability for project execution, issue resolution, risk mitigation, and adherence to established quality and delivery standards

* Oversee PeopleSoft PUM and PeopleTools upgrade initiatives across HCM, FSCM, ELM, Pensions, and other PeopleSoft applications while coordinating fit\-gap analyses, impact assessments, and customization retrofit strategies
