**About Reel25**

Reel25 is a short\-form video intelligence platform for agencies, brands, and founders. Customers add public TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts accounts or videos by URL, then use one dashboard to track performance, compare creators, spot emerging patterns, and understand which content converts.

The product works across individual videos and thousands of accounts, with recurring metric refreshes, analytics, AI\-assisted niche research, and tools that turn proven patterns into new scripts.

**The opportunity**

We are looking for an IT Project Manager to help Reel25 plan and deliver product, integration, and platform initiatives with clarity. You will coordinate work across engineering, product, design, and business stakeholders while keeping scope, risks, decisions, and dependencies visible.

We are open to candidates from project management, technical program management, delivery, implementation, or product\-operations backgrounds and will calibrate scope to experience.

This is a delivery role; coding experience is not required. You should be comfortable discussing these systems with engineers and turning technical work into clear plans, decisions, risks, and stakeholder updates.

**What you'll own**

* Turn product and technical goals into clear milestones, owners, dependencies, and acceptance criteria.
* Coordinate releases spanning frontend, backend, data workflows, integrations, infrastructure, and customer communication.
* Run lightweight planning, status, risk, and retrospective processes that help teams move faster.
* Identify blockers early, drive decisions to closure, and escalate with useful options.
* Maintain a reliable source of truth for priorities, delivery health, scope changes, and outstanding decisions.
* Partner with engineering leads on capacity, technical dependencies, reliability work, and release readiness.
* Coordinate incident follow\-ups and ensure agreed actions are completed.
* Improve delivery metrics and team workflows without unnecessary ceremony.

**What success looks like**

* Teams understand priorities, ownership, dependencies, and the definition of done.
* Risks and scope changes are visible early enough to support good decisions.
* Releases become smaller, more predictable, and easier to communicate.
* Cross\-functional meetings produce decisions and actions.
* Stakeholders receive concise, evidence\-based updates they can trust.

**What we're looking for**

* Experience helping deliver software, SaaS, data, integration, implementation, or comparable technical projects.
* Understanding of how product, frontend, backend, data, QA, and infrastructure work connect.
* Ability to organize multiple workstreams, dependencies, risks, and stakeholder expectations.
* Clear written communication, facilitation, prioritization, and follow\-through.
* Comfort discussing APIs, data workflows, cloud systems, testing, releases, and incidents with engineers.
* A pragmatic approach to Agile practices and process.

We do not require a particular degree, a fixed number of years, or a perfect match to every bullet. If you can demonstrate the core capabilities and are ready to learn the rest, we encourage you to apply.

**Helpful extras**

* Analytics products, AI\-enabled SaaS, social\-platform integrations, or subscription products.
* Scrum, Kanban, PMI, PRINCE2, or similar training; certification is not required.
* Privacy, security, compliance, vendor review, or incident follow\-up.
* Experience in a fast\-moving product environment.

**Why join**

* Work at the intersection of creator marketing, social data, analytics, and applied AI.
* Help customers replace manual spreadsheets and hours of scrolling with reliable product workflows.
* Influence a fast\-moving SaaS product used by agencies, brands, and founders.
* Solve meaningful scale, data\-quality, and user\-experience problems across multiple social platforms.

Pay: $80,000\.00 \- $100,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid time off

Work Location: Remote

* Lead customer release and maintenance planning, including IT calendar management and version control to maintain regulated compliance posture.


Account \& Business Management* Build senior executive relationships across customer stakeholder organizations, including procurement, program management, and security compliance teams.
* Identify and develop upsell and service expansion opportunities across SAP NS2 cloud offerings, in collaboration with Sales and Solution teams.
* Support renewals, contract extensions, and commercial change requests ensuring alignment with compliance and delivery goals.
* Drive Cloud Application Services operating profit reviews and ensure service\-level adherence and SLA management.


Education \& Experience Requirements:* Bachelor’s Degree (or equivalent experience) in Business Administration, Computer Science, Technical Engineering, or a related field.
* 7\+ years of customer\-facing program or delivery management experience, preferably within Federal, DoD, or Fed\-CIV environments.
* Deep understanding of DoD Cloud security models, FedRAMP compliance, and NIST frameworks.
* Proven ability to lead delivery for multiple customers while maintaining high compliance and service quality standards.
* Strong executive communication, relationship building, and stakeholder management skills.

* Demonstrated adaptability and innovative mindset toward adopting new technologies, such as AI and automation, to optimize delivery performance and operations.
* Experience with SAP or SAP NS2 preferred.


Desired Professional Training \& Certification:* ITIL Foundation or higher certification preferred.
* Working knowledge of SAP NS2 Cloud models, operating processes, and Federal compliance standards.
* Familiarity with DoD IL2–IL6 certification levels, FedRAMP, DISA STIGs, and related regulatory frameworks highly desirable.

*As with any dynamic technical environment, responsibilities will evolve based on mission needs. We are looking for individuals who are adaptable, proactive, and eager to take ownership of new challenges as they arise.*

new_jobs.title: Program Manager, Product Management
new_jobs.description:
**The Program Manager provides Product Management leadership with a single, trustworthy view of progress on the organization's strategic, large\-scale initiatives.** Examples include: product modernization, AI, and other transformational projects across a portfolio of 40\+ industry\-specific software products. Working at the intersection of product, engineering, and leadership, the Program Manager owns accurate status reporting, milestone tracking, and risk visibility for these key projects, **translating complex project details into clear, decision\-ready reporting for executives and stakeholders.**

This is a highly visible, cross\-functional role that succeeds through influence, disciplined communication, and data rather than direct authority. The Program Manager works directly with product owners and cross\-functional project teams to keep high\-stakes initiatives on track, and gives leadership a real\-time, honest picture of progress across the organization's most important product bets.


What You'll Do


**Manage and Report on Key Strategic Initiatives**

* Manage and support key large\-scale product projects. Actively manage progress on the organization's strategic product initiatives including product modernization, AI/ML integration, and other transformational, multi\-quarter projects as examples, partnering closely with product owners and project teams to keep work moving against plan.
* Own status reporting to leadership. Build and maintain accurate, timely, executive\-ready status reports and dashboards for key projects, giving leadership a clear, consolidated view of progress, milestones, budget/resourcing status, and delivery timelines across the portfolio.
* Track project health and key metrics. Define and monitor the milestones, KPIs, and success metrics for each large\-scale initiative, translating detailed project activity into concise, decision\-ready insight for leadership and flagging projects that are off track.

**Keep Initiatives On Track**

* Identify and escalate risks and issues. Proactively identify risks, issues, blockers, and cross\-team dependencies threatening a project's scope, schedule, or quality; maintain a clear view of open items and escalate to leadership with recommended paths forward.
* Run project governance and cadence. Establish and facilitate a regular cadence of project reviews and checkpoints with project teams and leadership ensuring each key initiative has a consistent forum for reporting progress, making decisions, and resolving blockers.
* Drive accountability across project teams. Hold project owners and cross\-functional contributors (engineering, design, product marketing, product management, sales, customer success) accountable to committed timelines and deliverables, following up on action items and unresolved issues between checkpoints.

**Communicate and Support Decision\-Making**

* Communicate with stakeholders. Tailor communication of project status and impact for different audiences, from individual project teams to senior executives, keeping stakeholders informed and aligned throughout each initiative's lifecycle.
* Support prioritization and planning. Provide leadership with the visibility needed to make informed trade\-off and sequencing decisions across the portfolio of large\-scale initiatives, based on current progress, risk, and resourcing.

**Who You'll Work With**

Product Management, Engineering, Design, Product Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success, as well as the Product leadership team. You will be the connective tissue that turns complex project details into consistent, decision\-ready reporting, and an honest, real\-time picture of how the organization's most important initiatives are performing.


**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 3–5 years of program or project management experience.
* Demonstrated experience managing and reporting on the progress of strategic projects from initiation through delivery.
* Hands\-on proficiency using AI tools for program management and reporting.
* Utilization and integration of AI in daily workflows.
* Proven ability to build clear, accurate, executive\-level status reports and dashboards and to present project progress confidently to senior leadership.
* Experience identifying, tracking, and escalating project risks, issues, and dependencies, and driving resolution with cross\-functional teams.
* Experience establishing and running project governance cadences (e.g., steering committees, project reviews, checkpoint meetings).

**Preferred**

* PMP certification; PgMP.
* Experience managing large\-scale, complex, or transformational initiatives in a software/SaaS or technology environment.
* Experience in a large, multi\-product software organization or a portfolio shaped by mergers and acquisitions, where products operate with a high degree of autonomy.
* Familiarity with ERP or vertical\-market/industry\-specific software.
* Experience working within or alongside a Product Management organization with product roadmaps and release processes.
* Experience presenting project updates to senior executive audiences.

**How Success Is Measured**

Performance is measured on a paired set of leading and outcome indicators across the role:


* **Reporting reliability.** Timeliness, accuracy, and leadership\-rated trustworthiness of status reporting and dashboards for key strategic initiatives.
* **Risk visibility**. Early identification and escalation of risks and issues — measured by how often problems are surfaced in time for leadership to act, rather than discovered after the fact.
* **Initiative outcomes**. On\-time, on\-track support of the organization's key modernization, AI, and other large\-scale product projects, and leadership\-rated confidence in the governance cadence.

* Overall planning, coordination, execution, and delivery of endpoint engineering and deployment initiatives.

* Support transition\-in, steady\-state operations, and required transition planning/transition\-out activities.


***What******qualifications do you look for?***

* Experience coordinating cross\-functional teams and managing project schedules, risks, deployments, and operational transitions.
* PMP, CAPM, ITIL Foundation, PMI\-ACP, or equivalent industry\-recognized project\-management certification(s).
* Must undergo a High\-Risk Background Investigation and complete a 7\-panel drug screening.

We offer outstanding benefits including health, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, and work\-life programs. Our award programs acknowledge employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our service standards. Full\-time and part\-time employees working at least 20 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in our benefit programs. Other offerings may be provided for employees not within this category.


Terrestris is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EOE). Qualified applicants are considered for employment without regard to age, race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, disability, or veteran status. Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S.

**Why This Role Exists**

D\&G is seeking an **Operations Research Analyst** to support Federal Government clients by designing, executing, and interpreting mission\-level modeling and simulation for complex logistics challenges. This position develops rigorous simulation scenarios for traditional heavy cargo and unmanned aerial cargo concepts, evaluates operational trade\-offs, stress\-tests network assumptions and constraints, and translates quantitative results into actionable capability gaps and return\-on\-investment (ROI) insights.


The role combines strong technical modeling skills with defense logistics knowledge to help government stakeholders understand where, when, and under what conditions alternative logistics concepts provide operational value.


**What You Will Do**


* Design and execute modeling and simulation algorithms or tools in support of logistics use cases, with a specific focus on heavy airlift cargo and Unmanned Aerial Systems (UAS) cargo requirements.
* Develop and execute credible, repeatable simulation scenarios that directly address defined logistics use cases and decision questions.
* Conduct comparative trade\-space analyses between manned and unmanned platform capabilities.
* Evaluate variables including payload capacity, runway independence, turnaround times, and overall network throughput.
* Design and execute sensitivity analyses and constraint testing to identify operational vulnerabilities and tipping points.
* Assess conditions such as degraded communications and denied runways to determine when UAS platforms gain or lose operational advantage.
* Synthesize raw simulation outputs and analytical metrics into actionable operational insights.
* Identify capability gaps and develop return\-on\-investment (ROI) narratives for government stakeholders.
* Translate complex quantitative findings into decision\-ready analytical products that clearly connect model outputs to mission impact.

* Experience presenting modeling and simulation results, capability gaps, or ROI analyses to Federal Government stakeholders.

*Preferred*

### **About Point**


**✨ Real Impact, Real People:** Our mission at Point is to make homeownership more valuable and accessible. Your work directly helps homeowners access their wealth, achieve financial flexibility, and realize life changing goals.


**✨ Funding:** With over $175M raised from top investors like Andreessen Horowitz, WestCap, Greylock, and Prudential, we're scaling fast! You have the opportunity to join us at a pivotal stage.


**✨ Game\-changing Product:** We're building a category defining company in home equity. We've earned a 4\.7 Trustpilot rating and an A\+ from the BBB, a testament to the value we provide to our 20,000\+ customers.

**✨ Remote First Culture, Genuine Connection:** Work from anywhere in the U.S., while staying closely connected through virtual collaboration, team gatherings, and a people\-first culture.

  


**Local or 100% Remote**

  


**About the role**



Point Digital Finance is expanding its Information Security function, and this is the team's first dedicated monitoring and response hire — a high\-visibility role with immediate, measurable impact. As Senior Security Operations Analyst (Detection \& Response), you will be the second half of an incident\-response rotation, partnering directly with the security lead to detect, investigate, and contain threats across a regulated consumer\-finance environment that protects the financial data of hundreds of thousands of homeowners. This is not an alert\-watching seat: you will engineer the detections, automate the response, and harden how we see our AWS, Google Workspace, and SaaS estate. You'll help stand up a modern detection \& response practice from an early\-stage footing, with the autonomy to own problems end to end and the mandate to turn noisy alerts into fast, repeatable, well\-documented response. If you like building as much as responding — and want your work to directly reduce risk to real people's financial lives — this role is for you.



Check out our latest Engineering Blog to learn more about why it's a great time to join Point's Engineering team!

  


**Your responsibilities**


* **Rotate on\-call and lead response:** share the 24/7 on\-call and incident\-response rotation with the security lead — triaging, investigating, and driving containment of security alerts and incidents.
* **Own response documentation:** build and maintain incident\-response runbooks, escalation paths, and post\-incident reviews so response is consistent and repeatable.
* **Engineer detections:** build, tune, and maintain SIEM detections, correlation rules, dashboards, and reporting in Coralogix across cloud and identity log sources.
* **Close coverage gaps:** reduce false positives and onboard new log sources to eliminate detection blind spots.
* **Own vulnerability management:** run day\-to\-day vulnerability management — prioritize findings, coordinate remediation with system owners, and report on risk reduction across cloud and endpoints.
* **Automate response:** develop detection\-as\-code and lightweight automation/SOAR so common alerts self\-triage and response is faster and repeatable.
* **Add operational redundancy:** serve as a redundant administrative and response path so containment is never bottlenecked on a single person.
* **Report and evidence:** produce recurring security metrics and reporting for leadership, and supply control evidence for audits.
* **Apply AI to the workflow:** use AI/LLM tooling to accelerate investigation, correlation, and detection engineering.
* **Improve the program:** contribute to continuous improvement of the security\-operations program, tooling, and threat monitoring.

  


**About you**


* 5\+ years of experience in security operations, incident response, SOC, or detection engineering (mid\-to\-senior individual contributor).
* Hands\-on experience running or actively participating in an on\-call / incident\-response rotation, independently.
* Strong SIEM skills — authoring and tuning detections, correlation rules, and dashboards (Coralogix, Splunk, Elastic, Microsoft Sentinel, or similar).
* Practical cloud security experience in AWS and Google Workspace, including identity and log sources.
* Demonstrated ability to investigate and contain incidents end to end — e.g., phishing/AiTM, account takeover, business email compromise, and cloud/identity threats.
* Working knowledge of vulnerability management and coordinating remediation with engineering teams.
* Scripting and automation ability (Python or similar) for detection\-as\-code and SOAR\-style workflows.
* Clear written and verbal communication — able to produce runbooks, metrics, and audit\-ready documentation.
* Comfortable operating with autonomy on a small team and owning problems end to end.
* Authorized to work in the United States, and able to participate in an off\-hours on\-call rotation.


**Nice to have**


* Hands\-on experience using AI/LLMs for security analysis, investigation, and alert engineering (detection authoring, correlation, tuning, and automation).
* Experience in a regulated financial\-services or fintech environment (GLBA, NYDFS Part 500, SOC 2\).
* Relevant certifications (e.g., GCIA, GCIH, GCED, GIAC, CySA\+, Security\+, or AWS Security Specialty).
* Experience standing up detection \& response practices from an early or greenfield state.

You will build the operating system that turns competitor activity, market developments, customer feedback, win/loss findings, and field signals into clear recommendations and action.


This is a highly visible, hands\-on leadership role for a senior individual contributor. You will strengthen Dropbox’s competitive positioning, improve how our teams navigate competitive sales cycles, inform product and go\-to\-market choices, and deepen executive understanding of a rapidly changing market. Your work will span both sales\-led and product\-led motions and help Dropbox tell a sharper, more differentiated story.


You will partner closely with Sales, Product Marketing, Product, Research, Revenue Operations, Analyst Relations, and Communications. Success requires equal strength in strategic judgment and execution: identifying what matters, developing a defensible point of view, and delivering useful recommendations and tools at the speed of the business.

* Equip customer\-facing teams to compete more effectively while partnering with product\-aligned PMMs to strengthen differentiation, objection handling, field confidence, and product\-specific competitive activation.
* Use AI, automation, and modern research platforms to scale the program, establish clear success measures, and maintain a trusted network of competitive contributors across Dropbox.

* Demonstrated ownership of an end\-to\-end competitive intelligence program, including executive intelligence, win/loss analysis, field enablement, and strategic recommendations.
* A record of translating complex qualitative and quantitative signals into clear points of view that influenced product, go\-to\-market, or revenue decisions.
* Deep experience partnering with Sales, GTM Strategy, Product Marketing, and Product teams in competitive markets and customer situations.
* Strong executive presence and the ability to communicate concise, evidence\-based recommendations to senior leaders.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

**OVERVIEW**  

  

A popular year\-round destination, Governors Island is a 172\-acre island in the heart of New York Harbor located between Lower Manhattan and the Brooklyn waterfront. For almost two centuries, the Island was closed to the public, operating as a military base for the U.S. Army and, later, the Coast Guard. Today, an award\-winning new park is complemented by dozens of unique historic buildings, educational and cultural facilities, a rich arts and culture program and a 22\-acre National Monument managed by the National Park Service. Looking ahead, the long\-term vision for Governors Island focuses on continuing to expand year\-round public access by enlivening it with transformative public art and culture, extraordinary recreational and open space, and research and education dedicated to addressing the global climate crisis.

The Project Manager, Real Estate \& Planning supports all aspects of the planning, leasing, and development of the Island in furtherance of the Trust’s mission and financial goals.  

  

The real estate department’s portfolio includes ground leased public\-private development projects; turn\-key space leases, including collaboration with the Design and Construction team on delivery of new spaces; and seasonal concessions. The Project Manager will lead or assist in all phases of the department’s projects, including initial project planning, research, and modeling; preparation and management of RFPs or other solicitations; lease and other contract negotiations; funding and financing; and coordination of landlord and tenant improvements. Throughout, the Project Manager will be responsible for:* Managing project timelines, budgets, and key issues
* Timely responding to tenant leads and other inquiries, and maintaining a prospect pipeline for various projects
* Contracting and coordinating outside services, such as appraisals, surveys, and studies as necessary
* Tracking project progress, performance, and key milestones and maintaining clear and organized project files
* Clearly communicating with prospective partners, existing tenants, Trust leadership, and other stakeholders
* Working closely with colleagues in other departments including but not limited to Legal, Design and Construction, Property Management, and Public Affairs

**QUALIFICATIONS**
==================

**Education:*** Bachelor’s degree required; graduate degree in real estate, business, finance, public policy, urban planning, or similar field preferred.

**Experience:*** Minimum of two years of experience in a relevant field.

**Skills and Abilities:*** Proactive and self\-directed, with an ability to create and maintain project momentum, display a high degree of responsiveness and follow\-through, and juggle multiple high\-priority projects simultaneously
* Strong quantitative, financial analysis and real estate modelling (MS/Excel)
* Proven ability to contribute to complex negotiations
* Civic\-minded, with a strong commitment to advancing the Trust’s mission
* Experience with public space and public processes in New York City a plus
* Decision making and communication skills commensurate with a position that is frequently required to represent the organization with external parties
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, and an ability to synthesize complex issues and present them clearly
* Entrepreneurial spirit
* Valid drivers license

**Salary Range:** $75,000\-$85,000 per year  

  

**Location \& Schedule:** All positions are located on Governors Island. The position is in\-person four days per week and remote one day per week.  

  

**TO** **APPLY**  

  

We realize that not all applicants match 100% of the qualifications for a role. If you meet many but not all the criteria and feel you may be a good fit for this role, we encourage you to apply.  

  

The Trust for Governors Island values the importance of inclusion, accessibility and a diverse pool of applicants. The Trust for Governors Island does not discriminate on the basis of age, color, disability, genetic information, marital status, membership in an employee organization, military service, national origin, parental status, political affiliation, race, religion, sex (including gender identity), sexual orientation, sexual and other reproductive health decisions, or other non\-merit factor.  

  

**ABOUT THE TRUST FOR GOVERNORS** **ISLAND**  

  

The Trust for Governors Island (The Trust) is a nonprofit corporation created by the City of New York. It is responsible for the redevelopment and operation of 150 acres of Governors Island. The Trust's mission is to realize the full potential of Governors Island for the inspiration and enjoyment of all New Yorkers, demonstrating a bold vision for public space. For more information, visit www.govisland.org

This role provides structure and visibility across a complex portfolio of initiatives by managing project plans, facilitating stakeholder coordination, maintaining governance documentation, tracking key deliverables, and supporting leadership with operational reporting and project administration.


The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail\-oriented, and capable of managing multiple concurrent initiatives while helping leaders stay focused, informed, and accountable for project outcomes.

 **Project \& Program Coordination**

* Coordinate multiple Information Governance and Records Management initiatives simultaneously.

* Bachelor's degree in Environmental Engineering, Environmental Sciences, Geology, Biology, Meteorology, related fields, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of experience in program management.
* 5 years of experience implementing environmental programs in the tech sector.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree in Environmental Engineering, Environmental Sciences, Geology, Biology, Meteorology, or related fields.
* 8 years of experience managing cross\-functional or cross\-team projects.
* Experience or knowledge of mission critical operations with respect to high\-stakes environmental programs and communications management.
* Experience or knowledge of acoustical engineering and acoustical data analysis.
* Outstanding skills and experience in collaboration and relationship\-building with cross\-functional teams and executive\-level stakeholders, and strong problem\-solving and project management skills.

**About the job**
-----------------


A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi\-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross\-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.


Google Data Centers (GDC) make up one of the largest and most powerful computing infrastructures on the planet. The Environmental, Health and Safety (EHS) program enables compliance and safety excellence in design, construction, commissioning, deployment and operations of Google owned and third\-party data centers at scale.


As a member of the GDC Compliance, Security and Risk Management (CSRM) Environmental team, you will be responsible for developing, implementing and maintaining the environmental programs across the Google Cloud teams not only in compliance with the regulatory requirements but also by pushing the program boundaries to establish and forward looking community concerns related environmental programs. You will play a critical part in working collaboratively with cross\-functional teams across Google Cloud to identify programmatic gaps, develop and execute timely and scalable end\-to\-end environmental programs to protect Google’s interests and have a lasting impact in the data center communities. You will also provide program leadership and oversight to new and critical environmental initiatives to continue to create and iterate our Google EHS program.


The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.


We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting\-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world\-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.


Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  

  

US: $192000 \- $278000 (USD) \+ 20% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits  

  

Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Define and steer the global vision and strategy for GDC’s Environmental Programs, prioritizing community concerns related environmental program, aligning regional initiatives with evolving Google standards and global GDC operational models.

**Job Description:**


Rakuten International is a division of Rakuten Group, Inc., a Japanese global technology leader in services that empower individuals, communities, businesses and society. Headquartered in San Mateo, California with more than 4,000 employees worldwide, the Rakuten International business portfolio includes market leaders in e\-commerce, digital marketing, advertising, communications and entertainment. We create products and services that provide exceptional value by aligning members and the businesses that want to engage them in a shared community.

**Job Summary:**


Are you a strategic orchestrator who thrives in complex, global environments? We are looking for a Senior Program Manager to join our Global Team Management and Inclusion (GTMI) team to lead high\-impact initiatives that bridge the gap between complex business challenges and creative, scalable solutions.


This isn't a role for someone who needs a roadmap; this is a role for someone who builds them. You will act as a change agent, driving global programs from inception to delivery, exercising sound judgment, and maintaining autonomy to steer stakeholders toward successful outcomes without needing a "safety net."

* AI School Strategy \& Governance: You will be at the forefront of our enterprise\-wide AI transformation. new_jobs.description:
Finance and Business Planning is a highly mission\-driven organization. Our mission is to enable Meta to plan, prioritize, and execute as effectively as possible. We take a uniquely long\-term view towards business problems. It is critical that we operate with an independent and objective perspective and can represent our point of view to our partners and executive stakeholders. We serve as financial advisers to our business partners and own shared business goals and results where appropriate. We strive to balance our responsibility to support business partners with our responsibility to serve the long\-term mission and sustainability of Meta and act as stewards of the company's resources. This role requires strategic thinking, building connections and influencing stakeholders through effective communication, an analytical mindset, and a bias towards action. You will be challenged to understand and contribute to rapidly changing business models, drive collaboration across teams, develop recommendations on strategic investment decisions, craft annual and long\-term plans, and partner with leaders to solve problems and achieve goals. Our promise: you will gain invaluable experience in a position that offers significant responsibility, interaction with product and business leaders, and an opportunity to have a big impact.  

  

  

### **Business Operations Manager, New Revenue Initiatives Responsibilities:**

* Provide financial leadership across company\-wide planning cycles: long\-range plan (LRP), annual budget, and half\-year roadmapping
* Develop nuanced ROI and impact frameworks across headcount, expenses, and other investments that will influence key decision\-makers to allocate resources more efficiently
* Create/socialize data\-driven narratives and influence outcomes and decisions at the executive level
* Establish strategic partnerships with leaders of all levels and functions across business functions
* Help define and implement scalable financial processes to make us and our business partners more efficient
* Develop a solid quantitative and qualitative understanding of Meta's GTM, product, and business model with partners

  

  

  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 9\+ years of experience in business strategy, finance, analytics, or consulting and planning
* BA/BS in a quantitative field (data science, computer science, economics, finance, etc.) or an equivalent degree/experience
* Experience in data analytics, data visualization, and scenario\-based analysis
* Experience leading cross\-functional projects with executive stakeholders

  

  

  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience supporting Enterprise or SaaS based Go\-To\-Market motions and or new revenue lines with an emphasis on AI monetization (e.g. Subscriptions, Enterprise Contracts)
* Experience working in a complex, fast\-paced environment or in a high\-growth company
* Experience working directly with executives
* High level of ownership and experience in driving cross\-functional initiatives with minimal guidance
* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)

  

  

  

### **About Meta:**


Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.  

  

  

Meta is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Meta participates in the E\-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law. Please note that Meta may leverage artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies in connection with applications for employment.
  

  

Meta is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities in our recruiting process. If you need any assistance or accommodations due to a disability, please let us know at accommodations\-ext@meta.com.  

  

$162,000/year to $229,000/year \+ bonus \+ equity \+ benefits  

  

Individual compensation is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Compensation details listed in this posting reflect the base hourly rate, monthly rate, or annual salary only, and do not include bonus, equity or sales incentives, if applicable. In addition to base compensation, Meta offers benefits. Learn more about benefits at Meta.

---------------


Amazon Leo is Amazon’s low Earth orbit satellite broadband network. Its mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet to customers and communities around the world, and we’ve designed the system with the capacity, flexibility, and performance to serve a wide range of customers, from individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, government agencies, and other organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.  

  

Export Control : This position requires that the candidate selected be a U.S. Citizen in order to comply with U.S. government\-imposed requirements related to the nature of the work and/or where it will be performed.  

  

As a Senior TPM for Leo Enterprise Technology, you will own the strategy and execution of mission\-critical, enterprise\-wide programs that underpin Leo's global operations at scale. You will set the long\-term vision for how enterprise platforms—including SAP and tightly integrated systems—enable Leo's business, financial, and operational outcomes. This role helps driving alignment across multiple organizations, senior leaders, and external partners. You will define operating models, influence architectural direction, and establish durable mechanisms that enable predictable execution in a highly complex and ambiguous environment.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Define multi\-year strategy, roadmaps, and success metrics aligned to Leo’s business objectives
* Understand business requirements working with PMT, Business stakeholders, super users
* Anticipate systemic risks and dependencies before they impact delivery
* Raise the bar for program management excellence across the organization
* Work with engineering teams (SAP Developers, Functional designers, process designers, security, Admin and other members) to understand the effort needed
* Build project plans and sprint schedules understanding engineering team bandwidth
* Manage dependencies inside and outside of the team to get the team answers on time, unblock the team and execute to aligned project plan and business need by dates
* Identify and escalate risks, manage issue resolution
* Bring in project management best practices , setup right processes, align with existing processes to delivery results
* Setup Jira and other tools used for capturing and running projects and sprint cadence

  

A day in the life  

This role will be highly collaborative, requiring partnerships with cross\-functional leaders to drive positive results. This role requires ability to advocate on behalf of our customers (internal and external) and an ability to push back without being adversarial.  

  

You will tackle challenging, novel situations every day and have the opportunity to work with multiple technical teams at Amazon in different locations. You should be comfortable with a high degree of ambiguity and relish the idea of solving problems that haven't been solved at scale before. Along the way, we guarantee that you will learn a lot, have fun and make a positive impact on millions of people.

Here at Amazon, we embrace our differences. We are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. Amazon has ten employee\-led affinity groups, reaching 40,000 employees in over 190 chapters globally. We have innovative benefit offerings, and host annual and ongoing learning experiences. ------------------------

* 5\+ years of technical product or program management experience
* 5\+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
* Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi\-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership

new_jobs.title: Sr Program Manager, Process Improvement, GCF ACES
new_jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


\*\*Location is flexible.  

  

The Global Customer Fulfillment (GCF) Amazon Customer Excellence System (ACES) team is seeking a Process Improvement Specialist to drive network\-wide projects and innovate new processes at scale. The individual will be a Process Path Owner (PPO) within ACES, where you are responsible for defining and maintaining the highest standards within your area of ownership. You are the subject matter expert (SME) for your process path, ensuring that all stakeholders—Operations, Central OPS, Tech, and ACES—are aligned with the right standards, tools, and mechanisms to drive performance. The role is flexible in terms of location, but requires reporting to an on\-site office.  

  

Your role goes beyond maintaining the current state; you are expected to think big, define a 1–3 year vision, and drive continuous improvement through scalable solutions. Your success is measured by how effectively you establish standard work, enable adoption, and make process adherence automatic rather than audit\-dependent.  

  

The Process Improvement Specialist role will challenge you to push boundaries and lead transformative innovation while having the autonomy to make rapid data\-driven decisions and invent on behalf of Fulfillment Center (FC) Operators and Associates. In this role, you will work cross\-functionally with members from various teams, including Operations, Amazon Fulfillment Technologies (AFT), Supply Chain Optimization Technology (SCOT), QuBIT, Global Logistics, Inbound Supply Chain, Finance, etc... to deploy solutions at scale.
  

  

Key job responsibilities  

Standard Work  

* Define standard work for your process path for associates and managers.
* Document standards for the “Gold Standard” for station design
* Ensure inaccurate / conflicting content is deprecated


Stakeholder Management  

* Be the central leader between Tech, Central Ops (PE, learning, etc..), Programs, Safety and Operations.
* Design feedback loops with customers to identify top priorities.
* Define a clear roadmap with Tech, ensuring prioritization aligns with business needs.


Process Path Performance  

* Conduct current state analysis to identify performance, key pain points and inefficiencies.
* Develop short\-term actions (0 – 3 months) and long\-term (1–3 years) roadmaps.
* Implement continuous improvements through Kaizens, automation, and tech investments.
* Peak Expectations \& Retrospective – Drive conversation for readiness for peak periods by analyzing past data, defining key operational thresholds, and conducting post\-peak evaluations to improve future performance.


Metrics  

* Own business logic and act as the source of truth for process path metrics.
* Define critical metrics and set targets, upper and lower thresholds.
* Deprecate outdated metrics.
* This role requires 50% travel within the United States.\*

  

A day in the life  

You will start by looking at key metrics in your process path and for the programs you support. You will visit a site to that is in Alpha testing and work in path with associates to understand what is and is not working well for your your programs and products. You will lead stakeholder alignment calls to define the path forward and update stakeholders on testing. You will lead training sessions for leaders on how to leverage the tool or product.
  

  

Amazon offers a full range of benefits that support you and eligible family members, including domestic partners and their children. Benefits can vary by location, the number of regularly scheduled hours you work, length of employment, and job status such as seasonal or temporary employment.
  

  

The benefits that generally apply to regular, full\-time employees include:
  

* Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage
* Maternity and Parental Leave Options
* Paid Time Off (PTO)
* 401(k) Plan

  

If you are not sure that every qualification on the list above describes you exactly, we'd still love to hear from you!
  

  

At Amazon, we value people with unique backgrounds, experiences, and skillsets. If you’re passionate about this role and want to make an impact on a global scale, please apply!  

  

About the team  

GCF ACES’ mission is to raise the bar on Amazon's customer experience by delivering holistic solutions that optimize process, tech and systems across the supply chain while balancing short, mid, and long\-term value stream. Our key programs and products aim to improve business outcomes across People, Defect reduction, DEA, Speed and Productivity. In doing so, we strive to bring parity to regions and develop solutions that are globally scalable and adapted to local levels.
**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
* 5\+ years of program or project management experience
* Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 2\+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Knowledge of general AI tools
* Experience designing, implementing, and scaling upskilling, apprenticeship, or workforce development programs across large\-scale operations or corporate environments, including forecasting workforce needs and leveraging analytics to drive program decisions

**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Amazon's Worldwide Grocery Stores is searching for a Procore Administrator for WWRGD Store Development. This role sits at the center of one of the world's most ambitious physical retail portfolios. In this role, you will own the platform that our team and 3P providers use to plan, build, and operate hundreds of grocery stores across North America.  

  

If you are someone who thrives when they own a domain completely — who wants to be the expert people come to, not the implementer waiting to be told what to do — this role was built for you.  

  

You will own the day\-to\-day administration, configuration, training, and operational reporting for Procore across WWRGD's organization.
  

  

Here is what makes this role different:  

* You are the functional domain owner for Procore administration — not a support queue. You make the decisions about how the platform is configured, who has access, and how end users are trained and supported.
* Your work scales with the business. With One Instance consolidation underway, the decisions you make today about configuration, access governance, and training architecture will determine how hundreds of users across multiple brands experience the platform for years.
* You are the person people come to. Whether it is a new hire who needs to get up to speed, a project manager trying to understand a workflow, or a senior leader who needs a report on governance, a specific project, or how to look at a specific aspect of a project — you are the answer.
* You build the systems, not just use them. You will create the SOPs, the training materials, the reporting templates, and the governance documentation that makes the whole organization more consistent and self\-sufficient.
* You partner at the right level. You work closely with the Product Manager on enhancements and strategic initiatives — but your operational domain is your own.

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Own all day\-to\-day Procore administrations, including user provisioning, permission management, workflow settings, budget templates, inspection protocols, and tool/process configurations.
* Monitor system integrations daily, resolving routine failures and escalating non\-routine issues to the Product Manager; conduct monthly finance integration reconciliations to validate data accuracy across systems.
* Provide primary user support for all internal and external end users, resolving 80% of issues within 24 business hours; escalate complex issues with clear documentation.
* Own the design and delivery of all day\-to\-day Procore training programs — including role\-based onboarding curricula, refresher sessions, and training materials that keep end users current as the platform evolves.
* For strategic initiatives, enhancement deployments, or organizational change efforts: support delivery of training programs — contributing platform expertise, logistics, and end\-user readiness support.
* Maintain and enforce Procore\-specific business process documentation and SOPs, ensuring consistency across all user groups and that documentation is current, version\-controlled, and AI\-agent\-ready.
* Serve as the primary tester during User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for enhancements and integrations, owning configuration validation and test execution.
* Conduct regular data integrity and user access audits to identify and correct inconsistencies, close permission gaps, and ensure data supports accurate reporting and analytics.

  

A day in the life  

Your morning might start by resolving a routine data flow issue before the team notices it, and logging a ticket one that needs the Product Manager's eyes. From there, you lead a new\-hire onboarding session to get them up to speed. After lunch, you are on a call with the PMO team to walk through an idea to scale bulk initiative project uploads. In the afternoon, you work on a training module for a configuration update going live next month and review a UAT checklist for an enhancement that hits production next week. No two days are the same but the common thread is keeping the platform running, the integrations healthy, the users enabled, and the data trustworthy.

The WWRGD Operational Excellence team owns the execution governance frameworks, system administration, and process infrastructure that enable nine functional pillars — spanning construction, design, capital planning, procurement, facilities, and vendor management — to operate as one aligned organization. **About the job**
-----------------


A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi\-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross\-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.


Google Data Centers (GDC) make up one of the largest and most powerful computing infrastructures on the planet. The Environmental, Health and Safety (EHS) program enables compliance and safety excellence in design, construction, commissioning, deployment and operations of Google owned and third\-party data centers at scale.


As a member of the GDC Compliance, Security and Risk Management (CSRM) Environmental team, you will be responsible for developing, implementing and maintaining the environmental programs across the Google Cloud teams not only in compliance with the regulatory requirements but also by pushing the program boundaries to establish and forward looking community concerns related environmental programs. You will play a critical part in working collaboratively with cross\-functional teams across Google Cloud to identify programmatic gaps, develop and execute timely and scalable end\-to\-end environmental programs to protect Google’s interests and have a lasting impact in the data center communities. You will also provide program leadership and oversight to new and critical environmental initiatives to continue to create and iterate our Google EHS program.


The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.


We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting\-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world\-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.

**Company Description**  

Founded in 1989 and headquartered in Reston, Virginia, SOSi is a private defense and government solutions business specializing in advanced technology systems and mission support. Its capabilities include data science, software development, network engineering, intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance (ISR), and logistics.

 **Job Description** **\*Position is contingent upon contract award\***


SOSi is seeking a highly qualified Program Manager. The onsite Program Manager (PM) is designated key personnel and is responsible for the overall performance and daily operations of the Task Order (TO), serving as the Government's primary point of contact for all contract matters. The PM shall provide overall leadership and guidance for all contractor personnel assigned to the TO and is ultimately responsible for the quality and efficiency of the TO, to include both technical issues and business processes. The PM has full organizational authority to execute the requirements of the TO, commit the contractor's organization, and make decisions on behalf of the contractor in response to contract issues, concerns, or problems. The PM manages cost, schedule, performance, and risk across all project activities, oversees the assignment of tasks to contractor personnel, and provides high\-level supervision of ongoing technical efforts across the Integrated Intelligence Centers (IICs) and Integrating Organizations. The PM works closely with the eight (8\) senior\-level Team Leads to ensure the optimal use of assigned resources and subcontractors, ensures staffing thresholds are met, and manages surge and optional task requirements as directed by the customer.

**Essential Job Duties**

* Serve as the primary point of contact and onsite authority for all contract matters, designated in writing to the Contracting Officer.
* Provide overall leadership and guidance for all contractor personnel assigned to the TO across all IICs and Integrating Organizations.
* Be ultimately responsible for the quality and efficiency of the TO, including both technical issues and business processes.
* Oversee and manage all aspects of project operations to ensure production schedules are met and system resources are utilized efficiently.
* Assign tasks to contractor personnel and provide high\-level supervision of ongoing technical efforts.
* Coordinate with and direct the eight (8\) senior\-level Team Leads.
* Be responsible for cost, schedule, performance, and risk identification/mitigation for all assigned tasks and personnel.
* Ensure compliance with staffing performance objectives, ensuring no position remains vacant more than 30 calendar days without an excusable delay.
* Manage overall TO performance to ensure the optimal use of assigned resources and subcontractors.
* Manage and coordinate surge support and optional task personnel requirements upon Government authorization.
* Ensure contract cost allocation and invoicing are properly tracked against the correct PWS Task, CLIN, SLIN, and ACRN in accordance with applicable clauses.

* Establish and maintain effective relationships with the Contracting Officer, COR, customers, and stakeholders.

**Qualifications** **Minimum Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (e.g., Intelligence, National Security, Business Administration, or related discipline).
* Minimum of 10 years of experience in program or project management within the defense or intelligence community.
* Demonstrated experience managing large, complex intelligence analysis or analytic\-enabling support contracts.
* Proven ability to manage cost, schedule, performance, and risk for complex projects.
* Experience leading and supervising large, geographically distributed, cross\-functional teams and subcontractors.
* Experience managing surge requirements and optional task execution.
* Organizational authority to commit to the contractor's organization and make decisions on its behalf.
* Strong leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.
* Experience coordinating with multiple Government stakeholders, including Contracting Officers and CORs.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master's degree in a relevant field.
* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or equivalent.

* Familiarity with analytic tradecraft standards (ICD 203/206\).
* Experience overseeing all\-source analytic and analytic\-enabling support across multiple functional and geographic mission areas.

* Fast paced, deadline\-oriented environment.

### **Position Description \& Qualifications**

  

  

Serco has a new Senior Risk Program Manager position available now in Arlington, VA with the F\-35 Joint Program Office (JPO).


The F\-35 Joint Program Office (JPO) is a joint, multi\-national program and is the Department of Defense’s (DoD) focal point for defining affordable next generation strike aircraft weapon systems among the United States (U.S.) Air Force (USAF), U.S. Navy (USN), U.S. Marine Corps (USMC), and U.S. allies currently composed of seven (7\) cooperative international partners: the United Kingdom, Italy, Netherlands, Canada, Australia, Denmark, and Norway; as well as Foreign Military Sales (FMS) customers. The F\-35 is the next generation strike fighter bringing cutting\-edge technologies to the battle\-space of the future. The F\-35’s advanced airframe, autonomic logistics, avionics, propulsion systems, stealth, and firepower will ensure that the F\-35 is the most affordable, lethal, supportable and survivable aircraft ever to be used by so many warfighters around the world. The JPO is a product\-aligned organization comprised of Program Management Offices (PMOs) designed to deliver five major products across the acquisition lifecycle: Air Vehicle, Propulsion, Combat Data Systems, Training Systems \& Simulation, and Maintenance Systems.


Our **Senior Risk Program Manager (PM)**, located at Crystal City, VA, supports the F\-35 Air Vehicle (AV) Program Management Office (PMO) providing lifecycle cost, schedule, and performance of aircraft, avionics, sensors, weapons integration, and modifications in the F\-35 Lightning II Enterprise. The PM supports AV PMO in delivering 5th Generation tactical aircraft to U.S. Services, Partners, and FMS customers.


In this role, you will:


* As the Sr Risk PM to support Air Vehicle:
	+ Serve as the Subject Matter Expert (SME) supporting the Production Execution Group in all areas of program risk management.
	+ Support Air Vehicle, Vehicle Systems, and Mission Systems PMOs with Program Executive Officer (PEO)\-level risk management activities and boards.
	+ Assist in the development, drafting, and revision of the Joint Program Office (JPO) Risk Management Plan.
	+ Facilitate and implement Risk Management Tool (RMT) training across the F\-35 JPO enterprise.
	+ Support and participate as the Risk Management SME in the JRWG, a monthly joint Government and industry risk forum, and the quarterly Joint Executive Risk and Opportunity Management Board (EROMB), including preparation and delivery of senior leadership briefings.
	+ Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively with senior\-level leadership and engage collaboratively with Government, industry, and cross\-functional stakeholders.
	+ Strong verbal and written communication skills with experience briefing complex risk issues, mitigation strategies, and program impacts to executive\-level audiences.
	+ Review and assess program documentation, including Systems Engineering Plans and related acquisition/program management artifacts, to support risk identification, analysis, and mitigation efforts.
	+ Experience coordinating across multiple stakeholders to facilitate risk\-informed decision\-making within a complex acquisition environment.
* As a SR Risk PM to support Air Vehicle (AV) Mission Systems (MS) in these areas:
	+ F\-35 Block 4 Modernization – assist AV PMO in providing airborne systems capable of operating effectively in highly contested battle spaces now and in the foreseeable future.
	+ Specialized Engineering – assist AV PMO in ensuring that the AV meets the approved design requirements.
	+ Weapons – assist AV PMO in providing lifecycle management of unique aircraft hardware that allow for carriage and employment of weapons; assist in coordinating across the F\-35 enterprise and external weapons programs to ensure necessary designs are implemented across the Air System to permit the effective employment of weapons.
	+ Digital Systems \- assist AV PMO in providing program management and life cycle support in the development and fielding of Digital Core, Digital Infrastructure, Software Development, Digital Engineering, and Cybersecurity initiatives.
	+ Air System Integration \- assist the AV PMO in life cycle management and support for the development, integration, and test of capabilities contained and fielded as an Air System Configuration.
* As a Risk PM to support AV Vehicle Systems (VS) in these areas:
	+ Air Vehicle, Air Vehicle Support Equipment, Pilot Flight Equipment, Ancillary Mission Equipment, Tooling and Test Equipment, Diminishing Manufacturing Sources, Initial Spares, Helmet Mounted Display System, and and Lightning Support Team.

new_jobs.title: Regulatory Operations Analyst III
new_jobs.description:
You could be the one who changes everything for our 28 million members. Centene is transforming the health of our communities, one person at a time. As a diversified, national organization, you’ll have access to competitive benefits including a fresh perspective on workplace flexibility.  



*Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for employment\-based visa sponsorship now or in the future. Sponsorship and future sponsorship are not available for this opportunity, including employment\-based visa types H\-1B, L\-1, O\-1, H\-1B1, F\-1, J\-1, OPT, or CPT.*

**Position Purpose:** Reviews, interprets and summarizes proposed and enacted legislation and regulatory updates to the business as a subject matter expert on various complex topics. Performs state or federal policy research, regulatory reporting, and regulatory change monitoring with a goal of supporting compliance, regulatory readiness, and formal regulatory approval of commercial and Marketplace products.

* Identifies, analyzes and interprets proposed or enacted legislation related to Centene's commercial product at the federal and state level and communicates findings to impacted departments.
* Independently performs risk assessments, including impact to business applications, claims operations, payment integrity processes, and downstream output.
* Maintains databases, reports, exhibits, and other reference materials related to legislative, regulatory, compliance, audit, and inquiry activities.
* Performs comprehensive, complex regulatory analyzes, including the review, summarization and dissemination of key regulatory updates and changes related to Commercial/ACA rules and regulations at the state and/or federal level.
* Leads regulatory interpretation related to Commercial/ACA Rules and regulations and the commercial product explaining concepts clearly and adapting language and presentation based on audience level.
* Provides guidance to business partners regarding emerging regulations, regulatory inquiries, audit activity, fraud, waste and abuse (FWA) oversight, and payment integrity matters.
* Coordinates regulatory inquiries, reporting requirements, exhibits, audits, and requests from state and federal agencies, maintaining accurate and timely responses in partnership with operational stakeholders.
* Partners with Compliance, Special Investigations Unit (SIU), Payment Integrity, Claims Operations, Finance, and other cross\-functional teams to identify regulatory risks, support investigations, and analyze operational trends.
* Uses persuasive arguments and secures cooperation from the business in order to address potential legal, contractual and/or regulatory issues.
* Ability to determine appropriate approach for solving regulatory problems.
* Develops trust\-based relationships within varied audiences and collaborates with other functional areas to lead large projects and initiatives.
* Attends cross\-departmental meetings as department representative, provides guidance to the business related to commercial regulatory requirements and appropriately escalates matters to management.
* Develops solutions to address potential legal, contractual and regulatory issues while working closely with Legal, Compliance, Payment Integrity, and other operational stakeholders.
* Independently drafts responses to external requests for information required by the organization for its regulatory filings and/or for policy needs.
* Responsibility for understanding regulations and business needs for multiple states, as well as federal regulations pertaining to the commercial health insurance market.
* Assesses and analyzes objections related to regulatory interpretation and leads drafting of appropriate responses which are provided to regulators related to commercial/ACA filings.

**Education/Experience:**

* Bachelor's Degree in Business, Communications, Healthcare, Political Science/Pre\-Law or equivalent experience required. Master's Degree in a related field, Juris Doctorate degree may be considered in place of experience preferred.
* 4\+ years experience in health insurance, legal, compliance or related field required.
* Experience reviewing regulations and providing interpretation using terms appropriate for the audience preferred.
* Experience in commercial health insurance, Medicaid managed care, claims operations, compliance, payment integrity, or related healthcare operations preferred.
* Experience partnering with Special Investigations Unit (SIU), Compliance, Fraud, Waste and Abuse (FWA), Payment Integrity, or related operational teams strongly preferred.
* Experience supporting claims operations, including medical claims processing, provider billing practices, payment accuracy, reimbursement workflows, or claims\-related regulatory activities strongly preferred.
* Experience analyzing claims data, billing trends, overpayment activity, provider utilization patterns, or operational risk indicators strongly preferred.
* Experience supporting regulatory audits, investigations, agency inquiries, corrective action plans, or regulator\-facing responses strongly preferred.
* Proficiency with Excel and experience using reporting, analytics, or business intelligence tools such as Power BI, SQL, SAS, or similar platforms strongly preferred.
* Experience within Medicaid managed care, including exposure to Medicaid Fraud Division (MFD), Medicaid Fraud Control Unit (MFCU), payment integrity, third\-party liability (TPL), or recovery activities strongly preferred.

***By applying to this requisition, you acknowledge and understand that you may be considered for other job opportunities for which Centene believes you may be qualified.***


Pay Range: $70,100\.00 \- $126,200\.00 per year
Centene offers a comprehensive benefits package including: competitive pay, health insurance, 401K and stock purchase plans, tuition reimbursement, paid time off plus holidays, and a flexible approach to work with remote, hybrid, field or office work

new_jobs.description:
Description:
**Bison Group – Mission First. People Always.**


At Bison Group LLC, we’re more than a defense contractor — we’re a people\-focused small business with a strong culture built on trust, respect, and impact. We value every member of the team, foster open communication without the layers of a big corporation, and stand firmly behind our commitment to the veteran community through real, tangible action.


When you join Bison Group, you’re not just filling a role — you’re stepping into a mission\-critical environment where your work directly supports the national security objectives. Here, your skills are recognized, your growth is encouraged, and your contributions have a clear purpose.

* Learn FMV tradecraft through a unique three\-week formal training course, followed by a robust on\-the\-job training program which provides candidates who may be new to motion GEOINT specialized instruction in FMV tradecraft, exploitation tools, and specific cultural familiarization
* Produce imagery\-derived graphic products and reports and publish for distribution
* Compile intelligence materials for use in briefings to high\-level government personnel
* Input data accurately, exploit FMV collected by sensors on ISR platforms, apply all\-source information to FMV imagery analysis, and use an electronic light table to exploit NTM imagery
* Have rapid advancement potential and cross training opportunities into Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR)/ Ground Moving Target Indicator (GMTI), and FMV Advanced Research positions.


Requirements:
* 3 years of intelligence analysis experience
* OR a bachelor’s degree in a related field
* Formal Intelligence school course (typically 2\+ months in duration, full time, resulting in an Intelligence MOS from the military (e.g. All\-Source, IMINT, SIGINT, HUMINT, etc.))
* Must be capable of working a rotating shift schedule, to include nights, weekends, and holidays
* During high\-tempo operations, maintain situational awareness and relay intelligence in real time
* Demonstrated ability to prioritize and solve routine tasks
* Working knowledge of MS Office, including MS Word, MS Excel, and Power Point
* Excellent analytical, writing, and critical thinking skills
* **Type 32 words per minute without looking at the keyboard at 90% accuracy**
* Understand the basic intelligence cycle/process
* Candidates must accurately discern red, green, blue, and yellow colors on a video screen
* Must successfully complete the customer FMV training course or have do so in the last year
* Must attain FMV analyst qualifications and maintain required minimum skill level in each

**Preferred Education, Experience, \& Skills**

* Basic understanding of National level imagery product standards
* Experience exploiting Full Motion Video with a basic understanding of sensor capabilities
* Familiarity with FMV operations and the TCPED process
* Experience exploiting national imagery with a basic understanding of imagery analysis
* During high\-tempo operations, can relay and articulate information
* Background in counterterrorism analysis
* Able to prepare and present briefings with creation/use of visual displays
* Can solve routine tasks of varying scope and complexity following Standard procedures

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy, national origin, age, genetic information, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability. new_jobs.title: Senior IT Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
Overview:

Looking to make a difference and help modernize critical government missions? Join Acuity's team supporting the U.S. Department of State. As a Senior IT Project Manager, you will lead the planning, execution, and delivery of multiple enterprise IT modernization initiatives, including Overseas Operations, Automation, and Overseas Data Storage programs. You will work closely with government stakeholders, program leadership, technical leads, and Agile delivery teams to ensure projects are delivered on schedule, within budget, and in alignment with mission priorities.
This role serves as the primary project delivery lead, coordinating cross\-functional engineering teams supporting cloud modernization, cybersecurity, infrastructure, automation, enterprise applications, and operational technologies across domestic and overseas environments.
Why Acuity?: Are you ready to use your expertise in the areas of IT Modernization, Data Enablement, and Hyperautomation to make a real difference? Join Acuity, Inc., a technology consulting firm that supports federal agencies. We combine industry partnerships and long\-term federal experience with innovative technical leadership to support our customers’ critical missions. Responsibilities:
* Lead the planning, execution, and successful delivery of multiple IT modernization projects supporting Overseas Operations, Automation, and Overseas Data Storage initiatives.
* Develop and maintain integrated project plans, schedules, milestones, resource plans, communication plans, risk registers, and project documentation across multiple workstreams.
* Coordinate cross\-functional teams supporting cloud engineering, cybersecurity, infrastructure, software development, networking, storage, and enterprise operations.
* Serve as the primary interface between government stakeholders, Program Management, technical leads, vendors, and engineering teams to ensure successful project execution.
* Manage project scope, schedule, budget, risks, issues, dependencies, and change requests while ensuring alignment with customer priorities and contractual requirements.
* Support enterprise modernization initiatives involving cloud adoption, infrastructure modernization, automation, data management, cybersecurity, and operational transformation.
* Oversee project execution supporting domestic and overseas technical environments, ensuring coordination across geographically dispersed teams and stakeholders.
* Facilitate Integrated Product Team (IPT) meetings, project status reviews, technical working groups, risk reviews, and executive briefings.
* Monitor project performance using key performance indicators (KPIs), project metrics, dashboards, and performance reporting.
* Coordinate Agile delivery activities including release planning, dependency management, sprint coordination, backlog prioritization, and cross\-team integration.
* Partner with Scrum Masters, Business Analysts, Product Owners, Modernization SMEs, and technical leads to ensure successful delivery of modernization initiatives.
* Coordinate project activities supporting DevSecOps, cloud engineering, cybersecurity, enterprise storage, automation, and application modernization efforts.
* Ensure project deliverables comply with Department of State governance, cybersecurity policies, quality standards, and federal project management best practices.
* Identify project risks and develop mitigation strategies to minimize schedule, technical, operational, and organizational impacts.
* Develop executive\-level reports, customer briefings, project status updates, decision papers, and management presentations.
* Support transition of completed capabilities into operations while ensuring operational readiness, documentation, and knowledge transfer.
* Promote continuous improvement, collaboration, Agile delivery, and project management best practices across all assigned modernization initiatives.
* Perform additional duties as assigned in support of customer mission objectives.

Qualifications:
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Project Management, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* Minimum of ten (10\) years of experience managing enterprise IT projects or programs supporting federal government customers.

* Ability to work after hours, weekends, holidays, and during emergency situations as necessary to meet the needs of the client
